name: Digo Bikash Samaj
description:
﻿﻿Vacancy Announcement

Date: 14 October 2025

Digo Bikash Samaj (DBS), Bhajani Kailali is an umbrella organization of community-based organizations (CBOs). It is a non-governmental, non-profit, and non-political organization registered with the District Administration Office and affiliated with the Social Welfare Council Nepal and NGO Federation Kailali. DBS works in the areas of livelihood, WASH and sanitation, disaster risk management/climate change adaptation, good governance, rights protection, and institutional capacity development.

DBS Bhajani Kailali is implementing the HATEMALO for Child Wellbeing and Integrated Development Project in partnership with World Vision International Nepal. The project is being implemented in Bhajani, Ghodaghodi, Tikapur, and Gauriganga Municipalities, and Kailari Rural Municipality of Kailali District. DBS is seeking qualified, dynamic, and motivated Nepali citizens for the following position:

Position: Women Economic Empowerment (WEE) Officer – 1 Position (Female Only)

Major Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support during annual planning of WEE interventions and approaches based on project scope.
  • Lead the implementation of WEE interventions and ensure timely progress.
  • Plan and integrate gender-responsive market assessments and other WEE-related assessments.
  • Develop WEE strategies and work plans based on assessment findings, ensuring a “do no harm” approach.
  • Support the monitoring team in data collection, analysis, and reporting of WEE outcomes.
  • Provide technical assistance and mentorship to project staff on WEE-related issues.
  • Conduct focus group discussions and other assessments to identify challenges and opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate records and prepare progress reports, sharing key findings with the project team and stakeholders.
  • Document best practices, lessons learned, and success stories from WEE initiatives.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, economics, social work, sociology, or a related field.
  • In-depth understanding of women’s economic empowerment (WEE) approaches and methodologies.
  • Proven experience in implementing WEE or livelihood projects, technical/vocational training, and working with financial service providers (FSPs).
  • Strong understanding of GEDSI, community-led initiatives, and local-level advocacy with government stakeholders.
  • Excellent facilitation, capacity assessment, and mentoring skills.
  • Ability to prepare and monitor budgets and track quarterly expenses.
  • Strong report writing skills for semi-annual and annual reports.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

Application Process:

Interested and qualified candidates are requested to send their application letter and CV to

dbsvacancy@dbskailali.org no later than 5:00 PM, 24 October 2025.

Please mention the position title in the subject line of the email. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage of the selection process. Telephone inquiries will not be entertained, and any inappropriate recommendations will automatically disqualify the candidate.

DBS Bhajani Kailali is an equal opportunity employer and strictly follows a merit-based selection process. People with disabilities and candidates from disadvantaged communities are strongly encouraged to apply.

Staff Selection Committee

Digo Bikash Samaj (DBS), Bhajani Kailali

name: Women's Rehabilitation Centre (WOREC)
description:
﻿﻿Expression of Interest

Women's Rehabilitation Centre (WOREC) is a non-governmental Human Rights organization dedicated to protecting and promoting Human Rights. Founded in 1991, WOREC focuses on preventing violence against women, addressing its causes and effects, and advocating for ecological justice through the economic, social, environmental, and cultural well-being of women and other marginalized groups. We envision a society where feminist aspirations are met, where everyone is equal, and social justice exists. Our working districts with offices are spread across Morang, Sunsari, Udayapur, Dhanusha, Mahottari, Sarlahi, Dang, Kailali, and Rukum, with additional working districts in Rupandehi, Kapilvastu, Kanchanpur, Kathmandu, Bhaktapur, Kavrepalanchok, and Saptari. The Central Office is located in Lalitpur.

1. EOI for Comprehensive Feminist Leadership Training (Sealed Proposals)

Link: EOI_feminist leadership - Ward members

2. EOI for Gender Inclusive Governance (Re-Call)

Link: Gender inclusive governance

Organizational Values

Accountability – Our commitment to achieving our goals with purpose and focusing on results entails taking ownership of our actions and ensuring that we hold ourselves accountable. We also advocate for accountability among others for their actions.

Intersectionality – We recognize that gender intersects with other aspects of identity, such as race, class, sexuality, and ability, emphasizing addressing multiple forms of discrimination and oppression.

Empowerment – We facilitate the empowerment of women, girls, and marginalized communities to have control over their own lives, choices, and bodies, free from societal constraints and expectations.

Social Justice – We advocate for a more just and equitable society, challenging systems of power and privilege that perpetuate inequality.

Inclusiveness – We value diversity and believe that every individual, irrespective of visible or invisible distinctions, has something valuable to contribute.

name: Reintegration of Returnee Migrant Workers (ReMi) Project/Helvetas Nepal
description:
﻿

﻿REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL

Date of first publication: 15th October 2025

The Reintegration of Returnee Migrant Workers (ReMi) project, initiated in July 2022, is a bilateral initiative of the Governments of Nepal (GoN) and Switzerland. The project is funded by the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (SDC) and implemented through a partnership between the Ministry of Labour, Employment and Social Security; respective provincial line ministries and 20 local governments in Koshi and Madhesh Province. Helvetas Nepal provides technical assistance on the project.

The project seeks to engage with qualified consulting firm/organizations with demonstrated expertise in development of reintegration module/toolkit and training manual which can be scalable across all local governments. 

  1. ReMi/Helvetas Nepal invites sealed Proposals from the qualified consulting firm/organizations. The detailed RFP document can be obtained by downloading from https://notice.helvetasnepal.org/.
  2. All sealed proposals must be submitted on or before 10 November 2025 at the latest by 1 PM. Proposals/documents received after the deadline shall not be accepted. 
  3. Proposals will be opened in the presence of applicants/representatives who choose to attend at 2 PM on 10 November 2025. Proposal must be valid for 90 days from the date of proposal submission deadline.
  4. A pre-proposal conference will be held on 30th October 2025 at 2:00 PM at ReMi/Helvetas Nepal Office, Dhobighat, Lalitpur. All interested applicants are invited to participate in this discussion. 
  5. ReMi/Helvetas Nepal reserves the right to accept or reject wholly or partly any or all bids without assigning any reasons whatsoever. 

Note: To participate in pre-proposal conference kindly send us email to remi.np@helvetas.org. Please note that only one participant per applicant is allowed.

﻿﻿Request for Proposal (RFP)

CONSULTANT FOR STUDY ON TFGBV IN LGBTIQ+ COMMUNITIES

This Terms of Reference (ToR) outlines the objective of this assignment, which is to conduct study on technology facilitated gender-based violence within LGBTIQ+ communities. The following are the specific objectives of this assignment:

  • Assess the status of the TFGBV in LGBTIQ+ communities in Nepal.
  • Identify opportunities, gaps and challenges in exercising digital rights by LGBTIQ+ communities at different levels.
  • Recommend possible interventions to enhance digital rights and online safety of LGBTIQ+ communities.

The submission deadline for proposal is October 27, 2025.

Vacancy Number: 2082/083-2

Date: 15 October 2025

Vacancy Announcement

Working for Access and Creation Nepal (WAC-Nepal) is a nonprofit, non-governmental and nonpolitical humanitarian development organization that is going to start the ''HATEMALO for Child Wellbeing and Integrated Development Project'' in partnership with World Vision International Nepal. The project will be implemented in Achham District for creating child-friendly governance and infrastructure that ensures safe, hunger-free households and holistic child development as the foundation for building skilled, civilized citizens and a prosperous future. WAC-Nepal is seeking qualified, dynamic and motivated Nepali citizens for the following positions in order to implement the HATEMALO for Child Wellbeing and Integrated Development Project in its working areas.

Position: Programme Coordinator

Required Position: 1 Person (Based in Safebagar, Achham)

Minimum Qualification and Experience:

The candidate should hold at least a bachelor's degree in agriculture, Economics, Enterprise Development, Climate Change, NRM, or related fields with 5+ years of project management experience, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of similar experience. They must demonstrate the ability to manage multiple projects and diverse teams, handle risks, uphold good governance, and work effectively in both development and emergency contexts, especially with regard to children’s wellbeing. The candidate should have strong technical expertise in livelihoods, climate change, women’s economic empowerment (WEE), GEDSI, child rights, and data management, along with solid project and financial management skills. The role also requires proven experience in team leadership and the ability to present performance insights using qualitative and quantitative data.

Major Responsibility:

The role and responsibilities of the Programme Coordinator will have to manage integrated program and advocacy portfolios to ensure strategic alignment, quality implementation, risk mitigation, and strong governance. It emphasizes data-driven, inclusive programming by integrating MEAL, GEDSI, DRR, and sponsorship elements to uplift marginalized communities and improve child well-being. The position requires community mobilization, capacity-building of field teams, and maintaining partnerships with local governments and protection actors. The individual must demonstrate adaptability, accountability, and leadership, promote sustainable local systems, and effectively communicate program results and impacts.

For more details visit the Job Description link for the post:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1I-VzYzonr0do791oWayX6qNK5vigf4PU/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=101388762448041391099&rtpof=true&sd=true

Position: Women Economic Empowerment (WEE) Officer

Required Number: 1 Person (Achham District)

Minimum Qualification and Experience:

The female candidate should hold bachelor's degree in agriculture, Economics, Social Work, Sociology, or a related field with strong expertise in Women’s Economic Empowerment (WEE) approaches.

Candidate must have experience in implementing livelihood or WEE-focused projects, including technical/vocational training, collaboration with financial service providers, and business plan development. The candidate should have minimum 1 year experience including advocacy skills for engaging with local governments on policy development, a solid understanding of WEE, GEDSI, community-led initiatives, and local advocacy, and the ability to work with diverse stakeholders across sectors.The candidate should also have strong training, facilitation, and mentoring skills, experience in budget forecasting, expense tracking, and report writing, as well as proficiency in capacity assessments and Microsoft Office applications.

Major Responsibility:

The role and responsibilities of the Women’s Economic Empowerment (WEE) Officer will have providing technical leadership and support for planning and implementing interventions. Key responsibilities include contributing to annual planning, leading WEE strategy development based on gender-responsive and market assessments, and ensuring a “do no harm” approach. The position requires collaboration with the monitoring team to collect, analyze, and report WEE outcomes, as well as offering technical guidance to project staff on WEE-related issues. Additional duties include facilitating focus group discussions, maintaining accurate documentation and reports, and capturing good practices and lessons learned from project initiatives.

For more details visit the Job Description link for the post:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CKr4mV3cEWeC2CT8eL-e79GrMMo9HWax/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=101388762448041391099&rtpof=true&sd=true

Qualified and interested candidates are requested to download and duly complete the prescribed Application and CV Form, and submit the completed documents via email to vacancy@wac.org.np no later than 24 October 2025.

The prescribed Application and CV Form can be downloaded from the link provided below:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZjkD2GQkz63cZqlNNoYGR5hnIqYHx9RG/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=101388762448041391099&rtpof=true&sd=true

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the subsequent stages of the selection process. WAC-Nepal reserves the sole right to accept or reject any or all applications, and to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason whatsoever.

Job Summary:

Kamal Rug Industries is hiring a Graph Painter to help prepare weaving graphs for rug production. The job involves painting and assembling printed design graphs (from Galaincha software) based on color numbers given by the designer.

The work is simple, calm, and low-stress—easy to learn and ideal for any age, especially older individuals. 

Responsibilities:

  • Assemble printed A3-size graphs according to rug size.

  • Paint over numbered boxes using different shades for clarity.

  • Keep graphs neat, accurate, and ready for supplier use.

  • Coordinate with designers when needed.

Requirements:

  • Basic color sense and attention to detail.

  • Neat and organized work habits.

  • No formal education required; experience in painting or graph work preferred.

  • All age groups welcome, especially senior or retired individuals.

Benefits:

  • Easy, low-pressure work environment.

  • All materials provided by the company.

  • Salary growth based on skill and performance.

﻿Vacancy Announcement for Various Positions

Background of Organization:

The Community Development Centre (CDC), established in B.S. 2049 by a group of dedicated development professionals and activists, is a well-recognized non-governmental organization with more than three decades of experience in community empowerment. With strong technical expertise, robust financial systems, and deep understanding of the local context, CDC has successfully led inclusive and multi-sectoral programs in Sudurpaschim Province. Its work spans across inclusive education, health, WASH, disaster risk reduction, youth engagement, child protection, and women’s empowerment. By addressing pressing challenges such as inadequate infrastructure, harmful social practices, governance gaps, low educational performance, and persistent barriers for marginalized groups, the organization has played a pivotal role in driving sustainable improvements in the lives of vulnerable communities.

CDC (Community Development Center) is implementing HATEMALO for Child wellbeing and Integrated Development Project in partnership with World Vision International Nepal (WVIN). The project is on implementation in Aadarsh RM, Sayal RM, DSMP municipality and Purbichauki RM of Doti District. Project Title: Emergency WASH Response and Resilience Support in Madhesh Province

Subject: Installation of Hand Pump Drinking Water Supply Scheme

Dalit Society Welfare Committee Nepal (DSWCN) is a non-governmental organization established in October 2001 AD and registered at District Administration Office (DAO) in Mahottari. DSWCN has been established to carry out different activities focusing on the welfare of children, youths and women, health and education, water and sanitation, sustainable environment, livelihood, income generation activities, disaster management, conflict, information and technology and other critical issues and right based issues.

The Integrated Community Development Project (ICDP) and the Emergency WASH Response and Resilience Support in Madhesh Province Project, implemented by DSWCN–Mahottari with financial and technical support from Good Neighbors International Nepal, invite sealed bids from eligible firms for the supply and installation of Hand Pump Drinking Water Supply Schemes

Eligible and qualified firms and companies can collect the Bid Document and further information from our office addresses given below or via email to dswcn.procurement@gmail.com

DSWCN–Mahottari will provide the bid documents free of charge upon registration of the firm for participation in the bid. The Expression of Interest (EOI) must include copies of the firm/company registration certificate, PAN/VAT registration, and the latest tax clearance certificate.

प्रथम पटक प्रकाशन मिति: २०८२/०६/२८ गते

हेफर इन्टरनेशनल नेपालको आर्थिक तथा प्राविधिक सहयोग र जनकल्याण यूवा समिती रौतहटको सहजिकरण र यस श्री लाली गुराँस समाजिक उद्यमी महिला कृषि सहकारी संस्था लि. गढीमाई नगरपालिका, समनपुर, रौतहटको सहकार्यमा सञ्चालित  तरकारी मूल्य श्रृखंला कार्यक्रम” को लागि तपशिलमा उल्लेखित पदका कर्मचारीहरूको आवश्यकता भएकाले यो सूचना प्रकाशन भएको मितिले ७ दिन भित्र दरखास्त दिनु हुन अनुरोध गरिन्छ ।

१. आवश्यक पदहरू:

क. पदको नाम: प्रशोधन केन्द्र व्यवस्थापक सह सहकारी व्यवस्थापक 

माग संख्या: १

मुख्य भूमिका र जिम्मेवारीहरू

  • सहकारीको दोहोरो लेखा प्रणालि अनुसार लेखा व्यवस्थापन गर्ने ।
  • किसानहरूबाट उत्पादित  तरकारीको सङ्कलन सहजीकरण गरी समयमै बिक्री सुनिश्चित गर्न व्यापारी, थोक बिक्रेता र खुद्रा विक्रेताहरूसँग समन्वय गर्ने ।
  • सहकारीको तरकारी व्यवसायको आर्थिक अभिलेख सहकारीको प्रणाली अनुरुप पारदर्शी रुपमा राखि नियमित रुपमा सहकारी सञ्चालक समिति तथा बजार व्यवस्थापन समितिमा जानकारी गराउने । 
  • बजार सूचनाका आधारमा बजारमाग अनुसारको उत्पादन, उत्पादन उपरान्तको व्यवस्थापनमा सहकारी सदस्यहरूको क्षमता अभिवृद्धि गर्ने ।
  • दैनिक बजार सूचना सङ्कलन गरी किसान तहमा बजार सूचना प्रवाह गर्न सहजिकरण गर्ने ।
  • सहकारी तथा प्रशोधन केन्द्रको व्यवसायको अवसर, सम्भावना तथा चुनौतिहरू पहिचान गरि व्यवसाय विस्तार गर्न सहजिकरण गर्ने ।
  • परियोना क्षेत्रका कृषकहरू र उत्पादनको म्यापिङ्ग तथा तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन र बजारको माग तथा आपूर्तिको मुल्याङ्कन गरि प्रशोधन केन्द्र तथा बजारसँग सम्बन्ध स्थापित गर्ने ।
  • सहकारी तथा प्रशोधनकेन्द्रको व्यवस्थापन, सञ्चालन तथा आवश्यक सुधारका लागि सहजिकरण गर्ने ।
  • सहकारी तथा तरकारी प्रशोधन केन्द्रको व्यवसाय बिस्तारका लागि मूल्य श्रृख्लाका पात्रहरूसँग सम्पर्क तथा समन्वय गरि व्यवसायिक सम्बन्ध स्थापित गर्ने ।
  • सहकारी तथा प्रशोधन केन्द्रद्वारा उत्पादित उत्पादनहरूको ब्रान्डिङ्ग तथा बजारीकरणमा सहजिकरण गर्ने ।
  • तरकारी प्रशोधन केन्द्रको व्यवसायिक योजना, दिर्घकालिन तथा रणनैतिक योजना तयार गरि कार्यन्वयन गर्न सहजिकरण गर्ने ।
  • स्थानीय सरकार तथा अन्य सरोकारबालाहरूसँग सम्पर्क तथा समन्वय गर्ने । 
  • मासिक तथा आवधिक प्रतिवेदन तयार गरि संस्था तथा सरोकारवाला निकायमा पेश गर्ने  ।
  • लेनदेन, बैठक र तालिमहरूको उचित रेकर्ड राख्ने।
  • मासिक प्रगति प्रतिवेदन तयार गर्नुहोस् र सहकारी/परियोजना टोलीलाई बुझाउने।
  • सहकारी सदस्यहरूको बचत संक्लनमा सहजीकरण
  • उचित लेखा, बहीखाता र वित्तीय प्रतिवेदन सुनिश्चित गर्नुहोस्।
  • वित्तीय दिगोपना कायम राख्न आम्दानी, खर्च र नगद प्रवाहको निगरानी गर्नुहोस्।  
  • लेखापरीक्षणलाई समर्थन गर्ने र वित्तीय नियमहरूको पालना सुनिश्चित गन

न्युनतम योग्यता र कार्यानुभव:

  • व्यवस्थापनमा प्रविणता प्रमाण पत्र वा सम्बन्धित क्षेत्रमा न्यूनतम मध्यवर्ती स्तर (१०+२) र कम्तीमा ५ बर्ष वा स्नातक र कम्तीमा २ बष अनुकार्यानुभव भएको ।
  • सहकारीको दोहोरो लेखा प्रणाली अनुसार लेखा राख्न सक्ने ।
  • तरकारी उत्पादन, बजारीकरण, र मूल्य शृंखलाको अनुभवलाई प्राथमिकता दिइनेछ 
  • बलियो सञ्चार र समन्वय सीप भएको 
  • आधारभूत कम्प्युटर ज्ञान (एमएस अफिस, एक्सेल) र रेकर्ड राख्ने क्षमता भएको ।
  • ग्रामिण क्षेत्रमा काम गर्न सक्ने तथा र नियमित फिल्डभिजित तथा यात्रा गर्नसक्ने ।

ख. पदको नाम: सहकारी तरकारी बजार प्रतिनिधि

माग संख्या: १

कार्यस्थल: तोकिएको सहकारीको कार्य क्षेत्र

मुख्य भूमिका र जिम्मेवारीहरू

  • प्रशोधन केन्द्र दैनिक रुपमा सञ्चालन तथा व्यवस्थापन गर्ने ।
  • प्रशोधन केन्द्रमा प्रशोधन तथा बजारीकरण हुने कृषिजन्य बस्तुहरूको दैनिकरुपमा अभिलेखिकरण गरि प्रतिवेदन तयार गर्ने ।
  • प्रशोधन केन्द्र सञ्चालन गर्न आवश्यक दक्ष तथा अदक्ष जनशक्तिको व्यवस्थापन तथा क्षमता अभिवृद्धि गर्ने ।
  • प्रशोधन केन्द्रको प्रयोगमा हुने मेशिनरी तथा औजारहरूको रेखदेख, व्यवस्थापन तथा नियमित मर्मत सम्भार गर्ने 
  • मासिक तथा आवधिक प्रतिवेदन तयार गरि सहकारी, संस्था तथा सरोकारवाला निकायमा पेश गर्ने ।

name: National Environment and Equity Development Society (NEEDS Nepal)
job-title: Consultancy: Development of a Short-Animated Video on Safeguarding (in Nepali)
description:
﻿Background:

NEEDS Nepal, a Kanchanpur-based NGO established in 1999, has been actively involved in enhancing community resilience to natural disasters, specifically in the districts of Kanchanpur and Dadeldhura. As part of the “Strengthening Community Preparedness, Rapid Response and Recovery in Nepal” project, in partnership with Oxfam in Nepal, the project aims to improve disaster mitigation and preparedness in communities by strengthening Early Warning Systems (EWS), integrating local response mechanisms, and enhancing government and community disaster management capacities. Oxfam and NEEDS Nepal are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment for all program participants, especially vulnerable groups. To strengthen awareness and understanding of safeguarding principles, we aim to produce a short, animated video in Nepali with subtitles in English language that communicates key safeguarding messages in an accessible and culturally appropriate way.

NEEDS Nepal is looking for eligible service provider for the consultancy services:

Consultancy: Development of a Short-Animated Video on Safeguarding (in Nepali)

TO APPLY:

Interested and eligible consultancy firms/companies registered in PAN/VAT are requested to submit their Cover letter expressing interest, Technical Proposal and the Financial Proposal along with CVs via email to procurement@needsnepal.org.np or at office of NEEDS Nepal Bheemdatt Municipality-18 Kanchanpur Bhashi. Please also include all legal documents of a consulting firm registration, company registration, latest tax clearance and Organizational Profile by 26 October 2025.

To download the detailed terms of reference, click on the link below:

https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1A2-ZXhuZQJYk-74HwbRuSXjP8DK4Mwo0

Safeguarding & PSEA:

NEEDS Nepal has a zero-tolerance policy and approach to any abuse, sexual harassment, or exploitation of, a vulnerable adult or child by any of our staff, volunteers, consultant, and suppliers.  All individuals and institutions have committed to respecting the core principles regarding the prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse laid out by the organization safeguarding policy, PSEA & code of conduct that is associated with the organization.

NEEDS Nepal has expected from all the staff to share this commitment through Safeguarding, PSEA Policy, and Code of Conduct. All staff must be committed to ensuring that all individuals we come into contact with through our work, whether team members, community members, program participants, or others, are treated with respect and dignity.

NEEDS Nepal

description:
﻿﻿साना किसान कृषि सहकारी संस्था लि.

पुष्पवलपुर मिथिला नगरपालिका -०४,धनुषा

समरर्सेवल पम्प सहितको बोरिङका लागि शिलबन्दी दरभाउ पत्र आह्वानको सूचना

शिलबन्दी दरभाउ पत्र नं ०१ –२०८२/२०८३

तेस्रो पटक सुचना प्रकाशित भएको मिती: २०८२।०६।२८

साना किसान कृषि सहकारी संस्था लि. पुष्पवलपुर मिथिला ना.पा.–४ धनुषाले GGGI द्धारा संचालित Climate Smart Agriculture (CSA) परियोजना अन्तर्गत Challenge Fund गतिविधी कार्यान्वयन गर्नको लागि यस सहकारी संस्था र GGGI को संयुक्त लगानी मा सिंचाइका लागी Installation of 80m Deep Medium Borewell with submersible pump जडान गर्नको लागि आवश्यक ड्रिलिग तथा अन्य उपकरणहरू खरिद गर्नुपर्नेछ ।

उल्लेखित परियोजना अन्तर्गत Agriculture Installation of 80m Deep Medium Borewell with submersible pump Set को लागि तपसिल अनुसारका आवश्यक ड्रिलिग तथा अन्य उपकरणहरू आपुर्तिको लागि सिलबन्दी दरभाउ पत्र आह्वान गरिन्छ । साथै देशै भरिका ईजाजत प्राप्त आपुर्ति गर्न इच्छुक अधिकृत/आधिकारिक बिक्रेता,आपुर्तिकर्ता तथा बितरकहरू बाट यो सूचना प्रकाशन भएको मितीले ६ दिन भित्र तपसिलको शर्तहरूको अधिनमा रही कार्यलय समय भित्र गोप्य शिलबन्दी दरभाउ पेश गर्नु हुन यो सूचना प्रकाशित गरिएको छ ।

आपुर्ति गरिने सामग्रिहरूको बिवरणः–

लिङ्कः– https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VSJEtfSBY4SNopP8J9xB-P2a9d31tv87?usp=drive_link

तपसिलः–

१. माथि उल्लेखित ड्रिलिग तथा अन्य उपकरणहरू एकमुष्ट वा छुट्टाछुट्टै खरिद गर्न सकिने छ। ईच्छुक अधिकृत विक्रेता, आपुर्तीकर्ता वा बितरकले आफुसंग उपलब्ध मेसिनरी तथा उपकरणहरू मात्रको लागि पनि शिलबन्दी दरभाउ पेश गर्न सकिनेछ । गुणस्तरिय मेसिनरी तथा उपकरण र बिक्रि पश्चातको सेवा सुबिधालाई उच्च प्राथमिकता दिईनेछ।

२. विक्रेतालाई भुक्तानी गर्दा बैंक खाता बाट गरिने र नियमानुसार लाग्ने कर कट्टी गरि मात्र भुक्तानी गरिने छ ।

३. उपरोक्त कारोबार असोज २८ देखि मंसिर १५, २०८२ सम्म संचालन गरिनेछ ।

४. ईच्छुक अधिकृत विक्रेता, आपुर्तीकर्ता वा बितरकले संस्थाको कार्यलयमा उपस्थित भई वा माथिको लिङ्कबाट दरभाउ पत्र डाउनलोड गरि प्राप्तगर्न सकिने छ । यो सूचना प्रकाशन भएको मितीले ६ दिनभित्र यस सहकारी संस्थाको कार्यलयमा दरभाउ उल्लेखित गरि पेश गर्न सकिने छ (अन्तिम दिन बिदा पर्न गएमा सो पछि कार्यालय खुल्ने दिनमा तोकिएको समयमा पेश गर्न सकिनेछ)।

५. शिलबन्दी दरभाउपत्र पेश गर्दा नविकरण भएको ईजाजत पत्र , आयकर दर्ता प्रमाण पत्र, भ्याट दर्ता प्रमाण पत्र र कर चुक्ता प्रमाण पत्रको प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि (आ.व. २०८१/२०८२ वा म्याद थपको पत्र सहित २०८०/२०८१ को कर चुक्ता ) पेश गर्नु पर्ने छ ।

६. शिलबन्दी दरभाउँ पेश गर्ने सप्लायर्स/कम्पनी/फर्महरूले दर्ता शुल्क वापत रु १,००० (फिर्ता नहुने गरि) संस्थाको उल्लेखित खातामा जम्मा गरि,जम्मा गरेको भौचर शिलबन्दी दरभाउसंग पेश गर्नु पर्ने छ ।

७. बोलपत्र फारममा उल्लेखित प्रत्येक ड्रिलिग, मेसिनरी तथा उपकरणको दररेट (कर समेत) अंक र अक्षर दुबैमा स्पष्ट लेखिएको हुनुपर्ने छ । अंकअक्षर बीच फरक परेमा अक्षरमा लेखिएकोलाई मान्यता दिईनेछ । केरमेट वा टिपेक्स लागेको अंक मान्य हुने छैन ।

८. कार्यालयमा प्राप्त हुने बोलपत्र फाराम खाम बन्द गरि लाहाछापले शिलबन्द गरिएको हुनु पर्ने छ, अन्यथा उक्त बोलपत्र दर्ता गर्न बाध्यहुने छैन ।

९. पेश गरिएका बोलपत्रहरु मिती २०८२ कातिक ९ गते ११ बजे सहकारी संस्था का पदाधिकारी, जि.जि.जि.आई. का प्रतिनिधी र बोलपत्र दाता स्वयम वा निज को प्रतिनिधीको उपस्थितीमा यस संस्थाको कार्यलयमा खोलिने छ । तोकिएको दिनमा बोलपत्र दाता वा प्रतिनिधी अनुपस्थित भएमा पनि शिलबन्दी दरभाउ खोल्न कुनै बाधा पर्ने छैन । तर सो दिन सार्वजानिक बिदा परेमा सो को लगतै कार्यालय खुलेको दिन सिलबन्दी दर भाउँ खोलिने छ ।

१०. म्याद नाघी वा रित नपुगी आएका बोलपत्र उपर कुनै कारबाही हुने छैन ।

११. अन्यशर्तहरु साना किसान कृषि सहकारी संस्था लि मिथिला ना पा ०४ .पुष्पवलपुर को खरिद नीती तथा नियमावली र नेपाल सरकारको प्रचलीत कानुन बमोजिम हुने छ । निर्णयको सर्वाधिकार साना किसान कृषि सहकारी संस्था लि .मिथिला नगरपालिका -४ ,पुष्पलवपुरमा निहित रहनेछ ।

name: Saathi
description:
﻿Warden (Female Only)–Residential

Saathi

Vacancy Announcement

Saathi is a leading non-governmental organization in Nepal established in 1991 to address the pressing issues of Violence Against Women (VAW) and Children. Since 2001, Saathi has been operating its Children’s Program to provide safe shelter, psychosocial support, education, and holistic care for children affected by abuse, neglect, poverty, and violence.

Job Description: 

Location: Nakkhu, Lalitpur (Junior Girls Safer Home)

Employment Type: Full-time, Residential

Reports To: Children Program Coordinator

Application Deadline: October 27, 2025

Salary: Negotiable

Position Summary:

The Warden will be responsible for the overall care, supervision, and emotional well-being of the children residing in the Safer Home. The role requires a compassionate, organized, and child-friendly individual who can maintain a nurturing and structured environment while ensuring the implementation of Saathi’s child protection and safeguarding policies.

This is a residential position for a female staff member. The post is not a family station, and accommodation is provided only for the staff member.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise daily routines including education, hygiene, meals, rest, and recreation for children.
  • Provide emotional support, consistent discipline, and conflict resolution guidance.
  • Monitor the physical and mental well-being of children and report concerns promptly.
  • Maintain cleanliness, safety, and a child-friendly environment across the home.
  • Encourage learning and development through structured activities and support from tuition teachers.
  • Serve as a key liaison with guardians, counselors, and the program team.
  • Keep updated records on each child and manage attendance, petty cash, and documentation.
  • Conduct regular inspections of the home to ensure facility safety and maintenance.
  • Promote hygiene and healthy living practices among children.
  • Demonstrate positive behavior and communication, modeling empathy and patience.
  • Address behavioral issues respectfully and ensure a supportive environment.
  • Participate in trainings and workshops relevant to child care and safeguarding.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Education, Psychology, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum age requirement: 30 years
  • Prior experience working with children, particularly in residential settings, is preferred.
  • Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills.
  • Proficient in both spoken and written English and Nepali.
  • Competence in computer applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, internet, email).
  • Must be flexible to work during off-hours, weekends, and emergencies.

Additional Requirements:

  • This is a full-time residential role; the Warden must reside on-site.
  • Willingness to work during weekends, holidays, or outside regular hours when required.
  • A police clearance certificate will be mandatory prior to appointment.

Application Procedure:

Interested candidates who meet the above criteria are requested to submit their CV and a cover letter (with two references) to saathi.vacancy@gmail.com by October 27, 2025.

Please mention the position title in the subject line of the email. 

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Phone inquiries will not be entertained.

name: Youth Innovation Lab
description:
﻿﻿Climate Fellowship Coordinator

Vacancy Announcement

Job Type: Full-time

Duration: 2 months (Short-term, Urgent)

Salary: NPR 75,000 (Gross, Negotiable)

About the organization:

Youth Innovation Lab (YI-Lab) is a not-for-profit civic tech company that operates at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and its applications, empowering young professionals to tackle emerging challenges in our communities. YI-Lab's mission is to engage young people in bridging science to people and policy through innovation. YI-Lab promotes open data, entrepreneurship, and evidence-based advocacy campaigns by leveraging indigenous knowledge, citizen science approaches, and developing cost-effective technological solutions. The organization provides a conducive environment for young people to co-create inclusive development solutions, with a focus on technology development, disaster risk reduction, climate change, open data, entrepreneurship, data-driven advocacy, youth engagement, and volunteerism.

About the project

Nepali Yuwa in Climate Action and Green Growth (TheYouthCAN.org) project is funded by the European Union to promote the involvement of young Nepali people in green growth, environmental protection, and combating climate change. TheYouthCAN.org is a four-year-long project that has been implemented in Madhesh Province, Karnali Province, and Sudurpashchim Province through the consortium partners Youth Innovation Lab (YI-LAB), Restless Development Nepal, CREASION, and CDMS.

TheYouthCAN.org focuses on working with young people, and empowering and providing them a platform to aid towards the post-COVID recovery and development process. Furthermore, the activities under Climate Fellowship, Climate Smart Entrepreneurship, Mentee-mentorship, Digital Advocacy, and Youth Sounding Board work towards empowering young people, providing them employment opportunities, generating innovative ideas to address climate and environmental issues, and advocating for policy changes to promote environmental protection.  

YI-Lab invites dynamic and enthusiastic Nepali citizens to apply for the following position. 

Job Description

The Short-Term Climate Fellowship Coordinator will support the final phase of the Climate Fellowship project, focusing on the coordination, finalization, and documentation of key deliverables. The coordinator will work closely with the DRR Expert, provincial and municipal governments, to finalize and endorse the Local Disaster Climate Resilience Frameworks (LDCRFs) across Madhesh provinces. The role includes organizing the Climate Fellowship Graduation Ceremony, conducting end-line assessments and monitoring visits, compiling final reports, and ensuring compliance with organizational and donor requirements to successfully close the project.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

1. Coordination and Implementation

  • Coordinate with provincial and municipal governments for the finalization and endorsement of the developed Local Disaster Climate Resilient Framework (LDCRF) in target municipalities.
  • Work closely with the DRR Expert and technical team to finalize and compile LDCRF reports of Madhesh Province
  • Support the organization of the Climate Fellowship Graduation Ceremony, including coordination with Climate Fellows, municipal representatives, and relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure smooth completion of all pending project activities in line with the approved work plan and donor requirements.

2. Monitoring, Evaluation, and Documentation

  • Coordinate and support the endline assessment of project municipalities to document results, challenges, and impacts of the Climate Fellowship program.
  • Conduct field monitoring and evaluation (M&E) visits as needed to verify data, collect feedback, and assess project outcomes.
  • Gather and document key learnings, success stories, and best practices from Climate Fellows and municipal engagements.

3. Reporting and Closure

  • Prepare and submit the final narrative and assist in financial reports of the Climate Fellowship project in coordination with the finance and technical teams.
  • Contribute to the project completion report, including summaries of activities, outputs achieved, and lessons learned.
  • Maintain proper documentation and ensure compliance with both organizational and donor requirements during project closure.

4. Coordination and Compliance

  • Maintain consistent communication with Climate Fellows, provincial focal points, and the DRR Expert throughout the finalization phase.
  • Ensure all activities and deliverables comply with YI-Lab’s policies and donor guidelines.
  • Provide timely updates to the project management team regarding progress, challenges, and completion milestones.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Climate Science/Studies, Disaster Risk Management, or any other relevant field. Master's preferred. 
  • At least three years of working experience in Climate Change Adaptation, Disaster Risk Management, Vulnerability and Capacity Assessment. 
  • Understanding and knowledge of Bipad Portal and prior experience of working with local governments to develop LDCRP is an advantage.
  • Working experience with young people and youth engagement is an asset.
  • Prior experience of working with EU/USAID/FCDO funded project would be a plus.
  • Ability to develop and maintain coordination and contact with partnered Provincial and Municipal governments
  • Coordinate with young people and guide them accordingly.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience in organizing events, consultation, and training.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Nepali.
  • Attention to detail, ability to follow procedures, meet deadlines, track progress, and work independently and cooperatively with team members.
  • Advance skill in using Computer and IT, and good experiences in using the digital platform.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and database management.
  • Knowledge of GIS, mapping tools, and data analysis will be highly preferred.
  • Ability to use digital communication tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Workspace).
  • Skills in designing tools such as Canva will be considered a plus point for communication and visibility.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for engaging diverse stakeholders.
  • Good organizational and time-management skills with ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Commitment to safeguarding, gender equality, and social inclusion (GESI).

Youth Innovation Lab promotes workforce diversity and gives priority to candidates from discriminated groups (womn, Dalit, Janajati, Madhesi/Terai, and other minority communities).

We are having interviews on a rolling basis, and encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

! Due to high application volume, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted within one week of the deadline. If you don't hear from us by then, consider your application unsuccessful.

Applying Procedure

Interested candidates are requested to submit their CV along with a cover letter.

Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

Deadline for submission of application: 20 October 2025

name: Nepal Disabled Women Association
description:
﻿﻿﻿Job Description

Introduction

Nepal Disabled Women Association (NDWA) is a non-government organization (NGO) established in 1998, led by women with disability. NDWA has been working since it's establishment for the ‘empowerment of women with disabilities to ensure and utilize their fundamental rights’ through focused program on education, health, livelihood, rehabilitation, meaningful participation and representation by doing advocacy, capacity building and awareness raising. Women with disabilities still face discrimination and isolation from the nation & community due to the lack of awareness, education, communication, access in health, poor economic condition, mobility barrier, less employment & job opportunities, lack of proper government system/mechanism, lack of supporting policies and proper implementation. NDWA with its work throughout the years has been able to achieve many positive results on education, health, economic, livelihood & opportunity. Much still needs to be done for the betterment of women with disabilities. 

NDWA is implementing this program under pillars ‘Meaningful Participation and Representation of girls/women with disabilities’ and ‘Advocacy and lobby work for policy formation and implementation’ and ‘Inclusive education, economic empowerment, livelihood, and rehabilitation for girls/women with disabilities.

The Nepal Disabled Women Association (NDWA) is seeking an experienced and highly qualified Nepali candidate to as Provincial GEDSI Lead/Trainers for ACCESS project—Accelerating Civil Society’s Role in Securing Education for All in Madhesh, Karnali, and Sudurpaschim Provinces. This initiative, led by People in Need (PIN). The main program aims to improve participation and advance equitable access to education in Madhesh, Karnali, and Sudurpaschim.

Scope of Work

Under the direct supervision of the NDWA Provincial GEDSI Lead/Trainers will support Project team in the effective implementation of the related activities under the project and represent NDWA at Provincial/local/district. This includes coordinating with provincial partners of consortia members (PIN, NCE, and ALN) supporting program, M&E department, and partners’ staff and district chapters in the implementation of project deliverable in the field. S/he will be responsible for management of activities trackers, information sharing across the organization, partners and other relevant stakeholders.

Various Position

1. Provincial GEDSI Trainer – “Accelerating Civil Society’s Role in Securing Education for All in Madhesh, Karnali and Sudurpaschim Provinces”, under the ‘ACCESS’ Programme

Opening: 1 position

Position: Provincial GEDSI Trainer

Location: Working areas Sudurpaschim Province (Kanchanpur, Achham, and Bajura) Based on Achham

Duration: One Year (with possibility of extension)

Reports to: Project Lead- ACCESS

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Manage operational aspects of the project, ensuring compliance with financial, administrative, logistics, communication, safeguarding, and procurement policies of NDWA and lead organizations.
  • Lead, guide, and support the project team to ensure quality project delivery, adaptive management, alignment with governmental programs, and effective mainstreaming of GEDSI, inclusivity, and safeguarding across all activities.
  • Coordinate with consortium partners, government agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure timely production of deliverables, clear communication, representation in forums, and collaboration for optimal project impact.
  • Act as the provincial focal point for communication, advocacy, networking, donor engagement, and community relations to enhance project visibility and influence policy dialogue.
  • Support monitoring, evaluation, and learning processes by coordinating assessments, analyzing program implementation, and applying findings to improve project outcomes and value for money.
  • Facilitate capacity building of CSOs and local partners, promoting inclusive education methodologies, transparency, and accountability through training and material development.
  • Ensure safeguarding compliance by embedding protection policies in all project stages, promoting awareness within teams, and managing risk, case handling, and emergency response effectively.
  • Conduct risk mapping and implement mitigation measures, including safeguarding and risk analysis at field level.
  • Help ensure systematic capture of sector-specific results, outputs, outcomes, and impact through effective M&E.
  • Implement planned activities, review progress, prepare reports, and document success stories and case studies.
  • Produce and submit timely written activity and outcome reports to Project Coordinator.
  • Ensure safeguarding of children, vulnerable groups, persons with disabilities, and conflict-affected populations.
  • Support NDWA monitoring, program departments, partners, and external evaluation teams to ensure ongoing monitoring, evaluation, and learning.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in education, social science/work, rural development, or relevant field, with at least 4 years of demonstrated work experience with an I/NGO in the following areas:
  • Knowledge and engagement/implementation of SESP, inclusive education, GEDSI, engagement in provincial AIN, clusters and relevant forums, working/handling CSOs and partnership skills will be value added.
  • Knowledge of working modality with MUAN, NARMIN, provincial - level GIEN, SMC and PTA federations and their mobilization
  • CBOs/CSOs capacity development and sub-granting; improving coordination in civil society space and with key community and LG/GoN stakeholders; community engagement/participation and local government mobilization.
  • Technical capacities to implement inclusive education methodologies, approaches, mobilization including strengthening of CSOs, Transparency and accountability of education plans across Local Government 
  • Proven experience in Girls and Inclusive Education Network across three layers of Government/school
  • Local language proficiency will be a plus.
  • Good verbal and written English and Nepali language
  • Experience working with diverse Civil Society Organizations and their meaningful participation in inclusive governance.
  • Outstanding communications and networking and reporting skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of gender and social norms in program design and implementation.

2. Inclusive Education Campaigner – “Accelerating Civil Society’s Role in Securing Education for All in Madhesh, Karnali and Sudurpaschim Provinces”, under the ‘ACCESS’ Programme

Opening: 1 Position

Position: Inclusive Education Campaigner

Location: Parsa, Madhesh Province

Duration: 10 Month (with possibility of extension)

Reports to: Provincial GEDSI Trainer – ACCESS

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Support Project Coordinator in managing field-level project implementation with consortium partners, provincial GEDSI Trainer, Federal GEDSI Technical Specialist, and project team.
  • Establish and maintain partnerships with key district-level partners and stakeholders.
  • Assist in adaptive management and facilitation approaches within the project.
  • Help ensure systematic capture of sector-specific results, outputs, outcomes, and impact through effective M&E.
  • Provide timely feedback for programmatic adaptations in collaboration with the Project Coordinator and GEDSI Trainer.
  • Conduct risk mapping and implement mitigation measures, including safeguarding and risk analysis at field level.
  • Coordinate with other SESP, education agencies, and relevant stakeholders locally.
  • Assist in development and oversee implementation of project interventions at field level.
  • Implement planned activities, review progress, prepare reports, and document success stories and case studies.
  • Collaborate closely with provincial GEDSI Trainer and NDWA/NCE/ALN teams.
  • Conduct capacity development and community engagement linked to project activities, including managing third-party grant support.
  • Coordinate with M&E, program departments, partners, and external evaluators for regular monitoring and evaluation.
  • Support Project Coordinator in ensuring finance compliance with project financial requirements.
  • Liaise with relevant government and non-government agencies/organizations.
  • Produce and submit timely written activity and outcome reports to GEDSI Trainer.
  • Ensure safeguarding of children, vulnerable groups, people with disabilities, and conflict-affected populations.
  • Act as focal point for NDWA communication, linkage, and sustainability at the field level.
  • Facilitate clear communication and coordination among NDWA, partners, government stakeholders, and beneficiaries; represent NDWA in district forums.
  • Support NDWA monitoring, program departments, partners, and external evaluation teams to ensure ongoing monitoring, evaluation, and learning.

Requirements


+2 in education, social science/work, rural development, or relevant field, with at least 3 years of work experience with an I/NGO in the following areas:

  • Knowledge and engagement / implementation of SESP, inclusive education, GEDSI prosperities, engagement in provincial AIN, clusters and relevant forums, working/handling CSOs and partnership skills will be value added
  • Knowledge of working modality with MUAN, NARMIN, province-level GIEN, SMC and PTA federations and their mobilization
  • Technical capacities to implement inclusive education methodologies and approaches and mobilization including strengthening of CSOs, Transparency and accountability of education plans across Local Government (LGs)
  • Proven experience in Girls and Inclusive Education Network across three tiers/school
  • Local language proficiency (Bajika, Bhojpuri, Maithili, Tharu) will be a plus.

description:
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿About the role

We are seeking a highly experienced  Lead Engineer with a proven track record of architecting and delivering complex SaaS applications. This role will be responsible for driving the technical vision, leading architectural decision-making, and ensuring our platform is built for scale and resilience. You will work hands-on with modern technologies including the  MERN stack, AWS cloud services, microservices, and serverless computing, while also providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers, and fostering a high-performance engineering culture.

This is a critical leadership role for an engineer who thrives on solving complex problems, building scalable systems, and guiding teams through technical challenges.

Codewing Solutions is a product-first company based in Kathmandu. Our software products power businesses in over 165 countries — from travel operators to bloggers and entrepreneurs.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Tripcart – SaaS platform for travel agencies
  • WP Travel Engine – WordPress plugin for booking websites
  • Rara Themes, Blossom Themes, and WP Delicious – trusted by millions globally

Tripcart is growing fast, and we need a lead engineer to scale it to the next level.

Location and Compensation

Location: In-office (Codewing, Chandol, Kathmandu)

Position Open: 1

Salary: 17 - 23 lakhs per annum

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the technical architecture of our SaaS platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Lead the design and implementation of microservices and serverless solutions  on AWS.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering Leadership to align technical decisions with business goals.
  • Guide and mentor engineers across teams, fostering professional growth and technical excellence.
  • Contribute hands-on to development in  PHP, JavaScript, and Python, with deep involvement in MERN stack-based applications.
  • Establish best practices for code quality, system design, security, and deployment.

﻿﻿﻿﻿शिलबन्दी बोलपत्र आह्वान गरिएको सूचना

(प्रथम पटक प्रकाशित मिति २०८२/०६/२८)

राष्ट्रिय कृषक समूह महासंघ नेपालले केएर नेपालसँगको साझेदारीमा सिरहा जिल्लाको भगवानपुर, सखुवानन्कारकट्टी, लक्ष्मीपुर पतारी गा.पा तथा धनगढीमाई न.पा., सप्तरी जिल्लाको रुपनी तथा अग्नीसाईर कृष्णासावरण गा.पा.संगको सहकार्यमा, जलवायु मैत्री गाँउ परियोजना सञ्चालनमा रहेको छ ।

उल्लेखित परियोजना अन्तर्गत तपसिल अनुसारका वीउ विजन र सिचाई सम्बन्धी सामग्रीहरु खरिद गर्नुपर्ने भएकोले मूल्य अभिवृद्धि कर वा मूल्य अभिवृद्धि करमा दर्ता नगरी सञ्चालन गर्न पाउने वीउ विजन तथा सिचाई सम्बन्धी सामग्री आपूर्ति गर्न पाउने भनी कानूनले तोकिदिएको हकमा प्यानमा दर्ता भएका उल्लेखित सामग्री आपूर्ति गर्न इच्छुक अधिकृत विक्रेता, आपूर्तिकर्ता तथा बितरकहरूबाट तपसिलको शर्तहरूको अधिनमा रही कार्यालय समय भित्र कार्यालयमा उपस्थित भई गोप्य शिलबन्दी बोलपत्र पेश गर्नु हुन वा ईमेल ठेगाना nfgfmadeshpradesh2075@gmail.com मार्फत आवेदन दिनु हुन यो सूचना प्रकाशित गरिएको छ ।

आपूर्ति गरिने सामग्रीहरूको विवरण:

क्र. स.कामको विवरणकैफियत
१बिउ बिजन उल्लेखि बीउहरूको गुणस्तरको प्रमणपत्र पेश गर्नु पर्ने छ ।
२सिंचाई सामाग्री

*नोट– माथिका सिफारीस गरिएको जातको बीउ नै उल्लेखित हुनुपर्ने छ ।

**सामाग्री ढुवानी माथि उल्लेखित पालिकाहरुमा गनुपर्ने छ ।

त्पशिल

१. माथि उल्लेखित सामग्रीहरू आवश्यकता अनुसार छनौट गरी खरिद गरिनेछ ।

२. विक्रेतालाई भुक्तानी गर्दा बैँक खाता बाट गरिने र नियमानुसार लाग्ने कर कट्टी गरी मात्र रकम भुक्तानी गरिने छ ।

३. उपरोक्त बमोजिमको कारोवार २०८२ साल असोज महिना देखि २०८३ साल भदौ महिना सम्म सञ्चालन गरिने छ ।

४.इच्छुक अधिकृत विक्रेता, आपुर्तिकर्ता वा बितरकले संस्थाको कार्यालयमा उपस्थित भई वा ईमेल nfgfmadeshpradesh2075@gmail.com मार्फत बोलपत्र प्राप्तीको लागि आधिकारीक पत्र मार्फत बोलपत्र प्राप्त गर्न सक्ने छ ।

५. बोलपत्र पेश गर्दा फर्म दर्ता प्रमाण–पत्रको प्रतिलिपि १ थान, फर्म भ्याट वा प्यानमा दर्ता भएको प्रमाण–पत्रको प्रतिलिपि १ थान, गत आर्थिक वर्ष को करचुक्ता प्रमाण पत्रको प्रतिलिपि १ थान व्यावसायीको नागरिकता प्रमाण पत्रको प्रतिलिपी १ थान, बैक खाता नं., सम्पर्क नं., ईमेल ठेगाना संलग्न गरी पेश गर्नु पर्नेछ । शिलबन्दी बोलपत्रको खाम बाहिर बोलपत्र दाताको नाम, ठेगाना, सम्पर्क नम्बर तथा फर्मको छाप अनिवार्य हुनुपर्नेछ । माथि उल्लेखित सामग्रीहरू मध्ये सम्बन्धित आपूर्तीकर्ताले उपलब्ध गराउन सक्ने सामग्रीहरूको मात्र दर भाउ उल्लेख गर्नु पर्ने छ ।

६. बोलपत्र फाराममा उल्लेखित प्रत्येक सामग्रीको दररेट (कर समेत) अंक र अक्षर दुबैमा स्पष्ट लेखिएको हुनु पर्नेछ । अंक र अक्षर बीच फरक परेमा अक्षरमा लेखिएकोलाई मान्यता दिइनेछ । केरमेट वा टिपेक्स लागेको अंक मान्य हुने छैन ।

७. बोलपत्र फाराम खाम बन्द गरी लाहाछापले शिलबन्द गरिएको हुनु पर्नेछ, अन्यथा उक्त बोलपत्र दर्ता गर्न बाध्य हुने छैन ।

८. पेश गरिएका बोलपत्रहरू मिति २०८२ साल कार्तिक २ गते २ बजे संस्थाका प्रतिनिधीहरू र बोलपत्र दाता स्वयम् वा निजको प्रतिनिधीको उपस्थितीमा यस संस्थाको कार्यालयमा खोलिनेछ । तोकिएको दिनमा बोलपत्रदाता वा निजको प्रतिनिधिको अनुपस्थित नभएमा पनि शिलबन्दी बोलपत्र खोल्न कुनै बाधा पर्ने छैन । तर सो दिन सार्वजनिक बिदा परेमा सो को लगत्तै कार्यालय खुलेको दिन बोलपत्र खोलिने छ ।

९. म्याद नाघी वा रित नपूगी आएका बोलपत्र उपर कुनै कारबाही हुने छैन ।

१०. थप जानकारी आवश्यक परेमा तल उल्लेखित फोन नम्बरमा कार्यालय समय भित्र सम्पर्क गर्न सकिनेछ ।

११. फाराम बुझाउने अन्तिम मिति २०८२/०७/०२ गते दिउँसो २:०० बजेसम्म हुनेछ ।

१२. अन्य शर्तनामाहरू राष्ट्रिय कृषक समूह महासंघ नेपालको सामग्री खरिद नीति नियमावली र नेपाल सरकारको प्रचलीत कानून बमोजिम हुनेछ । सर्वाधिकार राष्ट्रिय कृषक समूह महासंघ नेपाल नीहित रहेको छ ।

description:
﻿Terms of Reference (ToR)

For Consultant (write up) to update Milky Way Signature Program (2025-2035)

(Re-Publish)

(Note: Vendors who have already applied do not need to reapply.)

1. Background & Rationale

Heifer Project International Nepal (HPIN) is implementing a signature program "Milky Way- Transforming Dairy Sector of Nepal" in collaboration with Department of Livestock Services, National Dairy Development Board, Heifer Korea and other relevant stakeholders. It has a broad goal of enhancing dairy animal productivity and quality of products in a sustainable way through genetic improvement and adoption of climate friendly good dairy husbandry practices to help 500,000 smallholder dairy farmers to bridge the living income gaps.

Model Dairy Village (MDV) with nucleus herd of HF cattle has been established and in the process of establishing it for Jersey breed as well. The improved practices and technologies from MDV are currently being replicated/scaled to other areas of Nepal in coordination with dairy farmers’ institutions. There are still several constraints that keep the dairy sector far from reaching its full potential. Productivity particularly at smallholder farmers level remains low, limited adoption of climate friendly dairy technologies and practices, little incentive to invest in dairy given high production costs, poor cattle genetics, and volatile / unstable market conditions influenced by internal and external factors. To strengthen the resilience of smallholder dairy farmers against various shocks, existing program need to be revisited to address emerging challenges. Furthermore, Heifer International is in a transition mode and adopting a new program model to encompass food system transformation while still adhering t

In this context, HPIN is willing to update Milky Way Signature Program to align with the Heifer's new program model and the changing context. For this, several consultative meetings have been organized with large numbers of stakeholders, and the outcomes of the consultative meetings have been synthesized. HPIN is seeking a competent consultant to redefine and rewrite Milky-way signature program adhering to the new program and operational model incorporating the recommendations of the series of consultative meetings.

2. Objectives of Assignment

The main objective of this assignment is to update the existing milky way signature program aligning with Heifer International’s New Program and Operational Model and changing dairy ecosystem in the country and globally.

3. Scope of Work (SOP)

  • Fully understand Heifer International's New Program and Operational Model, its core elements, facilitators and objectives.
  • Review the existing Milky Way Signature Program document and figure out still relevant components, lacking components in changing national and international dairy contexts.
  • Review dairy related policies and identify core areas to be reflected in the updated signature program
  • Conduct consultative meetings with the Milky Way Signature Program Heifer Team and Collaborating Institutions to understand the progress made as of now under existing signature program.
  • Consult and work with previous consultative meetings facilitators and extract the essential components/ recommendations to be incorporated in the updated signature program.
  • Update existing theory of change, Result Framework and Key Indicators along with table of content, share to Heifer team and incorporate feedback for finalization.
  • Rewrite the Milky Way signature program incorporating the essence of original program components with addition of new and emerging issues aligning with the New Program and Operational Model of Heifer keeping in 10 years horizon.
  • Present the Updated Signature Program at Heifer office and incorporate the suggestions arising at the meeting.
  • Incorporate the feedback from Heifer Regional Office
  • Finalize and share the Updated Milky way signature program document.

4. Deliverables & Timeline: 2.5 Months (01 Nov 2025-15 Jan 2026)

S.N.DeliverablesSubmission date
1Inception reportWithin 1st week of contract
2Theory of Change, Result framework etc,Within 2nd weeks of contract
3Draft document: Milky Way signature programOn 7th week of contract
4Validation workshopOn 8th week of contract
5Presentation on updated signature programOn 9th week of contract
6Final updated signature program documentOn 10th week of contract

5. Requirements:

  • The consultant should have at least Master's degree, preferably a Doctorate in Animal Science/ Dairy Science or in any other relevant discipline from a reputed university with at least 15 years of relevant work experience.
  • The consultant should have clear understanding of dairy sector of Nepal and neighboring countries as well as dairy and other relevant policies of the country.
  • Previous experience of designing programs/ projects and writing winning proposals on Food system/ livestock / dairy development from bilateral /multilateral donor agencies (USAID, world bank, IFAD etc) as well as preparing strategic and policy documents for the government of Nepal. The consultant shall submit evidence of such task completion.
  • Excellent writing skills

6. Ethical Standards & Compliance

Mandatory adherence to: Do-No-Harm, PSEAH, child protection, data protection, animal welfare, and environmental safeguards.

7. Application Process

Interested individual consultants are invited to submit applications to Procurement-NP@heifer.org with the title: “Proposal for update Milky Way Signature Program” by no later than 27 October 2025, 5:00 PM along with following documents.

  1. Letter of Interest
  2. Technical proposal (understanding of ToR, methodology, work plan)
  3. Financial proposal
  4. Signed CV (maximum 3 pages)
  5. Relevant work samples (two recent documents/reports) or references.
  6. PAN certificate

HPIN reserves the right to accept or reject any proposal and to annul the selection process and reject all Proposals at any time prior to contract award, without thereby incurring any liability to affected individuals.

Working at VSO

VSO is a not-for-profit organisation that promotes volunteering as a powerful and practical way to tackle poverty and inequality. Our purpose is to create lasting change through volunteering.

At VSO, we believe in bringing about change, not by sending aid, but by working with volunteers and partners to empower people in some of the world’s poorest and most fragile regions. We know that people in developing countries have the desire, power, courage and determination to shape their own futures.

Through our Volunteering for Development (VfD) approach, we put the most marginalised people first. Grounded in years of evidence and learning, this approach develops active citizens who drive local community-led change and deliver sustainable development goals long after a project or grant ends.

Role Details

Location: Nepal

Application Closing Date: Oct 23, 2025 

Interview Date: As soon as possible

Start Date: As soon as possible

Download Job Description

Role Overview Summary

The National Volunteer – DRR & CSO Accountability Coordinator will work closely with VSO, strategic partners, and implementing partner teams to facilitate the implementation of the ACTIVE (Active Citizenship through Inclusive Volunteering & Empowerment) project. ACTIVE aims to foster inclusive, open, resilient, and gender-equitable societies by supporting transformative changes in thematic priorities of Humanitarian, Health, Climate and Economic Growth for marginalized communities.

Ideal Applicant Summary

Competencies and Behaviour

At VSO we believe progress is only possible by working together. Whether you want to join us as an employee, or as a volunteer working in your own country, overseas or online, our selection process includes an assessment based on these core competencies:

  • Ability to be resilient and adaptive to new situations
  • Ability to facilitate positive change and build sustainable working relationships
  • Ability to seek and share knowledge

Equal Opportunities: VSO promotes equal opportunities and values a diverse workforce.

VSO reserves the right to close this job early if we receive a sufficient number of applications.

Disclaimer: VSO is committed to a fair, transparent and merit-based recruitment. VSO does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Additional Information

Allowance and accommodation: All volunteers have an allowance paid in local currency. The allowance meets reasonable living expenses in country, but will not be enough to send money home.

संस्थाको जानकारी

“हाम्रो चाहाना सभ्य, स्वाबलम्बी र समावेशी समाज निर्माणको परिकल्पना” भन्ने मुल नाराका साथ, मिति २०५० भाद्र १० गते संघ संस्था दर्ता ऐन २०३४ अनुसार जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय दैलेखमा विधिवत् रूपमा दर्ता भएको एभरेष्ट क्लब दैलेख एक गैर नाफामुखी, गैरसरकारी संस्था हो । संस्थाले आफ्नो सम्पूर्ण कार्यक्रमहरूलाई सामाजिक न्याय, समानता, पारदर्शिता, जवाफदेहिता, सहभागिता, साझेदारी, दिगोपन र मानव विविधताको सम्मान जस्ता मूल्य मान्यतामा आधारित राखी सञ्चालन गर्दै आएको छ ।

स्थापना कालदेखि नै संस्थाले विपन्न, सीमान्तकृत, जोखिममा परेका र सेवाबाट वञ्चित समुदायलाई लक्षित गरी सामाजिक रूपान्तरणको विविध पहलहरू अघि बढाउँदै आएको छ जसले संस्थालाई दिगो विकास, सामाजिक सशक्तीकरण र समावेशी विकासका क्षेत्रमा अग्रणी भूमिकामा स्थापित गराएको छ ।

संस्थाले ‘जसको सवाल, उसैको सरोकार’ भन्ने मान्यतालाई आत्मसात् गर्दै, समुदायलाई आफ्नै विकास प्रक्रियाको केन्द्रमा राखेको छ । आजसम्मको ३२ वर्षभन्दा लामो यात्रामा, एभरेष्ट क्लबले कर्णाली प्रदेशका दैलेख, जाजरकोट, कालिकोट र जुम्ला जिल्लामा दिगो र प्रभावकारी विकासका अनेकौं पहलहरू सफलतापूर्वक कार्यान्वयन गरेको छ । संस्थाले आफ्ना गतिविधिहरूलाई खाद्य सुरक्षा र जीविकोपार्जन, शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, पोषण, लैङ्गिक समानता, अपाङ्गता र सामाजिक समावेशीकरण, वातावरण संरक्षण, जलवायू उत्थानशीलता, सुरक्षा र आपतकालीन राहत जस्ता क्षेत्रहरूमा प्राथमिकता दिएको छ । यी कार्यक्रमहरूले महिला, बालबालिका, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति, जेष्ठ नागरिक, लैङ्गिक अल्पसंख्यक, द्वन्द्व प्रभावित तथा गरिबीको रेखामुनि रहेका समुदायहरूको जीवनमा प्रत्यक्ष सकारात्मक परिवर्तन ल्याएको छ ।

एभरेष्ट क्लबले संघीय, प्रदेश र स्थानीय सरकारसँगै राष्ट्रिय तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय साझेदारहरूसँग नजिकको सहकार्य र समन्वय गर्दै कार्यक्रमहरू सञ्चालन गर्दै आएको छ ।

यसै सन्दर्भमा एकीकृत जलस्रोत व्यवस्थापन (IWRM) कार्यक्रम हेल्भेटास नेपाल संगको साझेदारी र एभरेष्ट क्लव दैलेखको प्राबिधिक तथा सामाजिक सहजीकरणमा निम्न तपशिल दैलेख जिल्ला र कालिकोट जिल्लाको स्थानिय तहमा सञ्चालन हुन गहिरहेको छ ।

दैलेख जिल्ला: नारायण नगरपालिका, दुल्लू नगरपालिका, चामुण्डा नगरपालिका, गुरासँ गाउँपालिका, डुङ्गेश्वर गाउँपालिकामा तथा महावु गाउँपालिका ।

कालिकोट जिल्ला: खाँडाचक्र नगरपालिका, रास्कोट नगरपालिका, नरहरिनाथ गाउँपालिका, शुभ कालिका गाउँपालिका तथा सान्नीत्रिवेणी गाउँपालिका।

उक्त कार्यक्रम अन्तर्गत तपशिलका विभिन्न पदहरूमा योग्यता सम्पन्न र इच्छुक नेपाली नागरिकहरूबाट आवेदन आव्हान गरिन्छ ।

माथि उल्लेखित कागजात सहित कार्यालयमा वा ईमेल hr@everestclubnepal.org.np मार्फत दरखास्त दिन सकिनेछ । म्याद नाघी आएका, तोकिएको शैक्षिक योग्यता नपुगेका, अनुभव नपुगेका, तोकिएका मापदण्ड पुरा नभएका वा रित पुरा नगरेका निवेदनहरु स्वीकृति गर्न संस्था वाध्य हुनेछैन । संस्थाले पूर्ण वा आशिंक कुनै पनि आवेदन विना शर्त स्वीकृत गर्ने वा नगर्ने अधिकार आफूमा निहित गर्दछ । प्रारम्भिक छनौटमा परेका उम्मेदवारहरुलाई मात्र लिखित तथा मौखिक छनौंट प्रक्रियामा समावेश गरिनेछ । सम्बन्धित जिल्ला र पालिकाका स्थानीय तह, यस अघि उस्तै प्रकृतिको कार्यक्रम परियोजनामा कार्य अनुभब भएका, समाजमा पछाडि पारिएका महिला, दलित, जनजाति, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति, सीमान्तकृत वर्गलाई दरखास्त पेश गर्नका लागि विशेष प्रोत्साहित गरिन्छ ।
