name: CRS Healthcare Pvt Ltd
description:
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Vacancy Announcement

1. Job Title: Sr. Officer- Business Development

Job Summary

This role is responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive business development strategy to increase market penetration and expand the product basket, thereby significantly enhancing its market presence, driving sales growth, and solidifying its position as a leading player in the Nepalese healthcare market.

Location: Head Office- Kathmandu

Qualification and Experience:

  • Minimum Qualification: Master's Degree in Public Health (MPH)
  • Minimum Experience: At least 2 years of experience in the identification of new products in the market.

For detailed ToR:  Sr. Officer- Business Development

2. Job Title: Sales Promoter

Job Summary

The position is accountable for generating demand for family planning and health products by promoting and ensuring supply in a definite geographical area.

The role will work towards maximizing the reach of CRSH products through coordinating with distributors, coverage of traditional and non-traditional outlets, distribution and re-supply, and supporting and conducting promotional activities. The role is also responsible for supervising Sales Promoters under her/him and ensuring that they are performing their tasks well.

Location: Butwal and Biratnagar

Qualification and Experience

  • Minimum Qualification: +2 completed in any discipline
  • Preferred / Additional Qualification: Training in the Art of Selling
  • Minimum Experience: 1 year of experience in sales and distribution
  • Preferred/ Additional Experience: 2 years of experience selling, distributing, and marketing FMCG and Medical products

For detailed ToR: Sales Promoter

3. Job Title: Officer- Marketing

Job Summary

The Marketing Officer leads the strategic planning, execution, and performance monitoring of CRS Healthcare’s marketing activities across its health product portfolio. The role ensures that marketing efforts are data-driven, consumer-responsive, and aligned with sales targets and procurement.

The role is expected to assist the marketing department in executing day-to-day activities.

Location: Head Office- Kathmandu

Qualification and Experience

  • Minimum Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Studies (BBS), or Business Administration (BBA), or Business Management (BBM)
  • Minimum Experience: At least 2 years of experience in the marketing of FMCG, maternal child health, or other health commodities.

For detailed ToR: Officer- Marketing

4. Job Title: OFFICER - IT/ MIS

Job Summary

The Officer – IT / MIS is responsible to implement IT strategies in line with the immediate and long-term organization objectives; provide prompt IT support to all CRS Healthcare employees across various locations of the organization for all systems and applications and ensure that employee queries are addressed promptly.

Location: Head Office - Kathmandu

Qualification and Experience

  • Minimum Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or Computer Science, or related field
  • Preferred / Additional Qualification: Process knowledge, including knowledge of hardware, setup and maintenance of central software ERP (such as Microsoft Dynamic NAV, GIS), GIS Mapping with ARC GIS/ QGIS, Software Programming, Sound Knowledge in Database Management System and network systems.
  • Minimum Experience: Two years of experience in the related field

For detailed ToR:   OFFICER - IT/ MIS

5. Job Title: Assistant Officer- Sales

Job Summary

The Assistant Officer – Sales is responsible for driving product sales, ensuring timely distribution, and maintaining a responsive supply chain across CRS Healthcare’s product portfolio. The role focuses on achieving sales targets, executing promotional activities, strengthening distributor and retailer relationships, and ensuring optimal product availability while minimizing expiry risks throughout the supply chain. Also, the role supports financial collections, market forecasting, and consumer engagement initiatives.

The role is also responsible for supervising Sales Promoters under her/him and ensuring that they are performing their tasks well.

Location: Janakpur and Sagarmatha

Qualification and Experience

  • Minimum Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline.
  • Minimum Experience: At least 2 years of experience in the sales and distribution of FMCG, or maternal child health, or other health commodities.

For detailed ToR:  Assistant Officer- Sales

To Apply:

Interested Nepalese applicants are requested to email their application to career@crshealthcare.org.np along with below documents by closing time, 5:00 PM of November 3, 2025, mentioning the applied position and location in the subject line. Candidates must mention the name of at least two references of a recent employer one of which must be the Head of Human Resources from their most recent employer

  1. Updated CV with relevant qualifications and experiences in chronological order starting from the most recent by closing time.
  2. Cover Letter highlighting how the candidate’s education and experience is relevant to the position.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified for further selection process. Enquiry through telephone or email at any stage of the process will not be entertained. CRS Healthcare reserves the right to contact the referees directly.

name: Caritas Nepal
job-title: Vacancy Announcement for Senior Project Officer-Project Lead
salary: Fixed Term (with Possible Extension Subject To Funding Availability)
description:
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Caritas Nepal is a non-profit organization dedicated to serving the poor, disadvantaged, and marginalized individuals, regardless of caste, creed, ethnicity, religion, or nationality. Founded in 1990 by the Catholic Church in response to devastating floods and natural disasters, Caritas Nepal aims to create a peaceful, equitable, and just society that fosters solidarity and respects human dignity. The organization focuses on social justice, community development, disaster risk management, sustainable livelihoods, support for migrants and refugees, anti-trafficking efforts, emergency response, recovery support, and advocacy on social issues.

Job Code: LIFE_SPO

Position: Snr. Project Officer-Project Lead - 1
Location: Jajarkot, Karnali Province, Nepal.
Reporting to: Provincial Manager- Kohalpur

Position Summary:

The Senior Project Officer will facilitate, coordinate, and ensure effective implementation of the LIFE Project in Jajarkot District, focusing on Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), Climate Change Adaptation (CCA), and Earthquake Preparedness.

 The position will be stationed with the local implementing partner organization, working closely with Caritas Nepal, partner staff, and local stakeholders. The role emphasizes technical support, and quality assurance, ensuring that activities are implemented effectively, inclusively, and in alignment with Caritas Nepal’s humanitarian principles, donor standards, and national frameworks.

Required Qualifications and Experience: 

  • Master’s degree in Disaster Risk Management, Climate Change Adaptation, Environmental Science, Development Studies, Social Science, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum Three years of progressive experience in project coordination, preferably in DRR/CCA or disaster preparedness.

  • Proven experience in community-based DRR, earthquake preparedness, and resilience programming.

  • Strong skills in project cycle management, M&E, and reporting.

  • Experience working with local governments, NGOs, and CBOs, preferably through partnership models.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills in English and Nepali.

 Key Competencies:

  • Demonstrate commitment to humanitarian principles, inclusiveness, and equity.

  • Exhibit professional integrity, transparency, and accountability in all work.

  • Be respectful, empathetic, and culturally sensitive in community engagement.

  • Show flexibility, adaptability, and problem-solving capacity in challenging field conditions.

  • Maintain a collaborative and learning-oriented attitude with strong interpersonal and communication skills. 

Technical Skills

  • Strong technical understanding of DRR and CCA strategies, frameworks, and tools.

  • Ability to design and facilitate trainings, simulations, and workshops.

  • Competence in participatory rural appraisal (PRA) and community mobilization methods.

  • Strong analytical, reporting, and documentation skills.

  • Ability to develop Terms of Reference (ToRs) for project staff, consultants, and activities.

  • Proficiency in MS Office

Other Requirements

  • Willingness to reside in Jajarkot and travel frequently to rural and remote sites.

  • Ability to work independently while ensuring close coordination with Caritas Nepal.

  • Commitment to Caritas Nepal’s mission, vision, and values.

  • Ability to function effectively in dynamic, resource-constrained environments.

Job Description

Click the given link for full Job Description: https://tinyurl.com/SpOLead

 How to apply:

You are required to fill up the job application form. Please click the link below. (Mandatory)

https://forms.office.com/r/vYJAcATYQF . And submit the documents (application letter, updated CV with references, and a recent photograph) to vacancy@caritas.org.np no later than 17:00 hours on October 27, 2025. Applications received after this deadline will not be considered. Your email subject contain the name of the position.


 Positions are either field based or involves extensive travel to villages / rural areas where living conditions are minimal. Only those willing to travel and committed to serve the communities in rural settings need apply. Caritas is an equal opportunity employer and encourage women / members of marginalized communities / disadvantaged groups to apply.

Caritas Nepal promotes its principles, strategies, policies, and procedures on Safeguarding (including Child Safeguarding and Protection from Sexual, Exploitation and Abuse), and Safety & Security and all applicants must adhere to Caritas Nepal’s key policies and procedures.

* Caritas Nepal reserves the right to make the final selection decision and may cancel or withhold recruitment at any stage of the process.

name: Dalit JanKalyan Yuba Club Lahan
description:
﻿दलित जनकल्याण युवा क्लव, लहान विगत २४ वर्षदेखि सिरहा जिल्लामा दलित अधिकार, भूमि तथा पोषण, खाद्य अधिकार, सुशासन, महिला अधिकार, शिक्षा, जीविकोपार्जन, खानेपानी स्वच्छता, तथा सरसफाई, हरवा चरवा अधिकार तथा दलित अधिकारको सवालमा काम गर्दै आइरहेको गैह्र नाफामुलक गैह्रसरकारी संस्था हो । हाल यो संस्था एक्सनएड नेपाल, वाटरएड नेपाल, द फ्रिडम फण्ड, र प्लान ईन्टरनेशनल नेपाल, मेनोनाइट सेन्ट्रल कमिटि (एमसिसि) नेपालसंग सिरहा जिल्लामा कामगर्दैआईरहेको छ । त्यसैगरी, यस संस्था विगतको दिनमा युएनडिपी, डिएफआईडि, केयर नेपाल र युकेएड जस्ता साझेदार संस्थासंग काम गरिसकेको अनुभव छ । 

यसै सन्दर्भमा मेनोनाइट सेन्ट्रल कमिटि ( एमसिसि ) नेपालको आर्थिक तथा प्राविधिक सहयोगमा “Inclusive & Quality Education for Children of Bariyarpatti & Nawarajpur Rural Municipality in Siraha” अन्तर्गत तपसिल बमोजिम कर्मचारीहरूको आवश्यकता भएकोले उल्लेखित योग्यता पुगेका इच्छुक नेपाली नागरीकहरूबाट दरखास्त आव्हान गरिन्छ । दरखास्तको लागि व्यक्तिगत विवरण (biodata) र आशय पत्र, लगायतका कागजातसहित  मिति २०८2 कार्तिक १ गते सम्म (२०२५ ओक्टोबर १८ तारिक बिहान सम्म) (7 दिन) भित्र यस लिङ्कमा: https://ee.kobotoolbox.org/x/7htx0D5z  र vacancy@djkyc.org मा इमेल गर्न वा दलित जनकल्याण युवा क्लव लहान न.पा वडा नं. १४, प्रदिप गिरीको आश्रम स्थित कार्यालयमा आवेदन दिन यो सुचना प्रकाशित गरिएको छ । साथै संस्थाको वेवसाईट: www.djkyc.org हेर्न सकिनेछ ।

बिज्ञापन नं. १  

पद: सामाजिक परिचालक ( १ जना ) 

कार्यक्षेत्र: बरियार पट्टी र नवराजपुर गाउँपालिका (मासिक बैठक, आवधिक समिक्षा, तालिम, पेश्की फर्छौट तथा प्रतिवेदनको काम बाहेक कार्य क्षेत्रमै रहनु पर्ने)

पदिय जिम्मेवारीको सारंश:

समाजिक परिचालकले पदमा रही संस्थाद्वारा संचालित समावेशी तथा गुणस्तरिय शिक्षा परियोजना मार्फत शैक्षिक सुधार मार्फत सामाजिक रुपान्तरणको लागि बिभिन्न काम तथा जिम्मेवारीहरू निर्वाह गर्नु पर्नेछ । यस संस्थामा काम गर्दा संस्थाको नीति, नियम, आचारसंहिताहरूलाई परिपालना गर्देसमाजिक परिचालनको कामहरू गर्नु पर्ने छ ।

योग्यता तथा अनुभव:

प्रवीणता प्रमाण पत्र उतीर्ण भई कम्तिमा सामाजिक परिचालकको रुपमा सरकारी तथा गैर सरकारी संस्थामा न्युनतम एक वर्ष काम गरेको अनुभव भएको वा एस.एल.सी. उतीर्ण भई सामाजिक परिचालक पदमा रही कुनै पनि सरकारी तथा गैर सरकारी संस्थामा कम्तिमा ३ बर्ष काम गरेको अनुभब भएको हुनु पर्नेछ ।

सुपरभिजन तथा जवाफेदहीता:

सामाजिक परिचालकहरूको कार्यक्रमको सुपरभिजन कार्यक्रम अधिकृतबाट हुनेछ भने सामाजिक परिचालकले आफ्नो सबै संस्थागत जिम्मेवारीका लागि कार्यक्रम अधिकृतप्रति जवाफदेही हुनुपर्नेछ भने प्रतिबेदन पनि कार्यक्रम अधिकृतलाई नै पठाउनु पर्ने छ ।

जिम्मेवारीहरू:

  • परियोजनाको लक्ष्य प्राप्तीका लागि सामुदायिक गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न लचिलो भई सामुदायिक परिवेश अनुकुल उपलब्ध हुनुपर्नेछ भने कार्यालय समयको हकमा दैनिक ७ घण्टा अर्थात हप्तामा ५६ घण्टा काम गरेको हुनु पर्नेछ । कार्यालयमा रहँदा तोकिएको काममा केन्द्रित रही अतिरिक्त समय भए आफ्नो जिम्मेवारीसँग सम्वन्धित क्रियाकलापमा संलग्न भई कार्यालय समयको अधिकतम सदुपयोग गर्नु पर्नेछ । 
  • परियोजनाको वार्षिक, अर्धवार्षिक र त्रैमासिक योजनासँग तादम्यता हुनेगरी आफ्नो साप्ताहीक तथा मासिक कार्य योजना बनाई समुदाय वा कार्यक्षेत्रमा परिचालित हुने । 
  • अनुकुल शैक्षिक वातावरणका लागि सामुदायिक सरोकारवालाहरू, विद्यालय, राजनैतिक नेतृत्व तथा नागरिक अगुवाहरू, जनप्रतिनीधिहरू सँग नियमित रुपमा समन्वय तथा सहकार्य गर्ने ।
  • बालमैत्री शैक्षिक वातावरणका लागि विविध सचेतनामुलक गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्ने 
  • विविध कारणले विद्यालय बाहिर रहेका विद्यालय उमेरका बालबालिकालाई विद्यालयमा ल्याउन समुदाय, तथा घरभेट गरी अविभावकहरूलाई परामर्श दिने ।
  • आफ्नो कार्यक्षेत्रका लक्षित बालबालिकाको अवस्था विश्लेषण गरी समस्याको कारणसम्म पुगेर आवश्यकता पहिचान गर्ने र प्राथमिकिकरण गर्ने ।
  • लक्षित समुदायमा सामुदायिक समुहहरू मार्फत अविभावक शिक्षा तथा सचेतना कक्षा सञ्चालन गर्ने ।
  • लक्षित बालबालिकाका परिवारको खाद्य सूरक्षा तथा जिविकोपार्जन सम्वन्धि समस्या समाधानका लागि अन्तर परियोजना समन्वय एवं सहकार्य गर्ने ।  
  • कार्यक्रमको निर्देशिका अनुसार सामुदायिक सिकाई केन्द्रहरूमा बालबालिकाहरूको सक्रिय सहभागिताका लागि आवश्यक भूमिका निर्वाह गर्ने  ।  
  • सामुदायिक सिकाई केन्द्रहरूमा नियुक्त स्वयं सेवकहरूको परिचालन, निरीक्षण तथा प्रतिवेदन गर्ने ।
  • परियोजना अन्तर्गत हुने कुनै पनि भौतिक वा आर्थिक सहयोग परियोजनाको मर्म अनुसार लक्षित बालबालिका वा परिवारले मात्रै पाउने सुनिश्चिताका लागि सहजिकरण गर्नुपर्नेछ । 
  • कार्य सम्पादनको क्रममा सधै संस्थागत मूल्य मान्यता, नीतिनियम, आचार संहिता प्रति सचेत रहनुपर्नेछ । 
  • सामाजिक परिचालकले परियोजना टिमसँग संयुक्त रुपमा कार्ययोजना बनाई कार्यान्वयन तथा सहजीकरण गर्नु पर्नेछ । 
  • संस्था तथा परियोजनाको श्रोत साधनको उपयोगमा अधिकतम मितब्ययिता अपनाई समुदाय र सरोकारवालाहरूसँग साझेदारी र सहकार्य मार्फत थप श्रोत जुटाउन पहल गर्नुपर्नेछ । 
  • महिनाभरी समुदाय/विद्यालयमा सम्पन्न गरिएको कामहरूको तोकिएको ढाँचामा तोकिएको समयभित्रै प्रतिवेदन गर्नुपर्नेछ ।  उपलब्धि, सिकाई तथा चुनौतीहरू मासिक  वैठकमा प्रस्तुत गरी आगामी महिनाको कार्यक्रमहरूको कार्य योजना वनाई कार्यान्वयन गर्नु पर्ने ।

पेश गर्नुपर्ने कागजातहरू:

name: Creasion
description:
﻿﻿﻿﻿VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Center for Research and Sustainable Development Nepal (CREASION) is a not-for-profit organization that was established in 2005. Since it was founded, CREASION has been a leader in environmental protection in Nepal through recycling, research, emergency response, grassroots and circular economy related interventions. CREASION also houses innovative, impact-based projects as well as a learning center for youth. CREASION’s work is majorly centered around four thematic areas; Environment and Sustainability, Disaster Risk Reduction, and Youth and Volunteerism.

CREASION Nepal announces vacancy open for various positions and would like to invite application from eligible Nepali citizens for suitable positions.

About the Project

Green Shift: Circularity of Plastic Waste for Net-Zero Carbon Nepal project is funded by the European Union to promote the circular economy. This is a four year-long project (2023-2027) will be implemented in Madhesh Province, Lumbini Province, and Bagmati Province through the lead partner CREASION and consortium partners Restless Development Nepal, and Youth Innovation Lab (YI-LAB).  The main goal of this project is to promote circular economy by establishingstrong plastic waste collection and recycling mechanism, promote plastic alternative products and engage key stakeholders in policy advocacy.

1. Position Name: Project Lead

Position Overview

The Project Lead is a key leadership role responsible for orchestrating and managing a multidisciplinary team to achieve the objectives outlined in the project. This position involves overseeing project activities, ensuring compliance with enlisted project standards, and collaborating with various stakeholders to drive successful project implementation and completion.

Project Lead will promote plastic waste management and reduction for a just transition towards Circular Economy and engage key stakeholders to advocate for inclusive and evidence-based policies for the promotion of Circular Economy. The Project Lead will oversee the overall implementation of project Green Shift. S/he will be responsible for the day-to-day strategic direction and supervision of the project team to ensure effective and efficient coordination and management of activities. S/he will supervise monitoring of project progress and is accountable for achieving planned project outcomes. The Project Lead is expected to exercise full compliance with the organizational rules and regulations.

Click on the link below for detailed JD: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NdFK4_Q_VNX2gI3E4rq7_YHZanSD55Do/view?usp=sharing

2. Position Name: Environment Officer

Position Overview

Environment Officer will work closely with the Project Lead and Project Implementation Team (PIT) to promote plastic waste management and reduction for a just transition towards Circular Economy and engage key stakeholders to advocate for inclusive and evidence-based policies for the promotion of Circular Economy. Environment Officer will ensure timely implementation of the activities: Strengthened capacity of waste enterprises for plastic waste collection and recycling, Opportunities created for businesses to develop sustainable plastic alternative products to support the transition to CE, Alliance of WWs strengthened for their inclusion in policy making process, Formulated SWM policy guidelines at local and provincial level and a recycling policy at federal level through the engagement of CSOs and youths.

Click on the link below for detailed JD: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xxedQ9eNG98bdvmFAvx-XtpJduQux9I7/view?usp=sharing

3. Position Name: MERL Officer

Position Overview:

This position will be responsible for developing and implementing Monitoring and Evaluations system and plan, including a database to store and aggregate collected data in terms of waste segregation and management. The MERL (Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning) Officer will provide technical expertise and leadership to generate and analyze quality evidence and data through monitoring, assessments, and evaluations. This position promotes learning and ensures accountability to both beneficiaries and donors.

Purpose of the Role

MERL Officer will work closely with the Project Lead and Project Implementation Team (PIT) to monitor and evaluate the implemented activities of the project, ensuring the standard of the deliverables.

Click on the link below for detailed JD: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1KoDvFA99Z20w0Bc5aX-uOR4FAqw6NRaO/view?usp=sharing

4. Position Name: Communications Officer

Position Overview: 

The Communication Officer will be responsible for creating and implementing communication plans that align with the goals and objectives of both the programmatic and commerical divisions. This role requires a strategic communicator who can effectively convey the organization's messages, enhance its brand image, and engage stakeholders across different sectors. Also, this role is responsible for providing substantial support in the creation and development of advocacy plans and strategies, as well as external communication and outreach initiatives for GreenShift Project.

5. Position Name: Finance Officer

Position Overview: 

The purpose of this position at the CREASION Office in Kathmandu is to maintain financial and administration systems and controls to ensure the efficiency, integrity and transparency of the project’s accounting, financial and administration activities in accordance with national regulations and approved policy and guideline.

Position Overview

Project Associate will work closely with the Program Coordinator at Restless Development and Project Implementation Team (PIT) to promote plastic waste management and reduction for a just transition towards Circular Economy and engage key stakeholders to advocate for inclusive and evidence-based policies for the promotion of Circular Economy. Project Associate will work closely with young people and ensure timely implementation of the activities Climate Smart Schools and Digital Volunteerism.

name: Lutheran World Relief
description:
﻿VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Lutheran World Relief (LWR), which is part of Corus International, has been present in Nepal since 2011. Corus International is the parent of a family of world-class organizations working to deliver the holistic, lasting solutions needed to end extreme poverty once and for all. We are a global leader in international development, with 150 years of combined experience across our brands. Our nonprofit and for-profit subsidiaries include IMA World Health and its fundraising brand Corus World Health, Lutheran World Relief, CGA Technologies, Ground Up Investing, and Farmers Market Brands. In Nepal, Corus operates under Lutheran World Relief. Our more than 400 employees around the globe are experts in their fields and dedicated to helping the world’s most vulnerable people break the cycle of poverty and lead healthy lives. Further details about the organization can be found at: https://corusinternational.org.

At Corus we believe that good only grows stronger and we reflect that belief in our workplace culture. We value every employee’s specialized area of expertise and nurture professional growth. We promote an engaging and supportive work environment, where employees feel enabled and driven to innovate, learn and collaborate. And because our subsidiaries often function as partners, our employees have the opportunity to work across our enterprise family. 

Lutheran World Relief (LWR) in Nepal seeks to recruit result-oriented individuals to fill the following positions;

﻿1. TECHNICAL SENIOR MANAGER, FINANCIAL SERVICES– ID:3876557

Reporting to the Chief of Party, the Technical Senior Manager (TSM), Financial Services, will be responsible for managing the technical delivery and activities on the project in supporting micro, small and medium enterprises (MSME) to access financial packages that develop and grow their businesses and expand LWR/Corus’ technical qualifications in programming to position LWR’s technical work. The position will be based in Kathmandu, Nepal.

Education & Experience

The ideal candidate should have a Bachelor’s with at least 7 years’ experience in finance, banking, business, enterprise development, or social science or equivalent combination of education and experience; Master’s is desired.  

S/he should have prior experience working in the FI/MFI, or within the banking sector, preferred. The candidate should have experience working with colleagues in a multicultural, multi-linguistic environment. Demonstrated experience managing terms and conditions as well as other international donors.

In addition, s/he should have proven track record of developing and maintaining strong working relationships with target beneficiaries, private sector entities, as well as host country counterparts and NGO/FBO/CBO actors.  Experience working with local and/or US-based and international partners (NGO/FBO/CBOs, universities and other technical institutions) is desired.

2. TECHNICAL SENIOR MANAGER, PRIVATE SECTOR ENGAGEMENT – ID:3876558

Reporting to Deputy Chief of Party, the Technical Senior Manager, Private Sector Engagement will be responsible for managing the technical delivery and activities on the project in aquafeed and aquaculture to expand private sector engagement to develop and grow the project and LWR/Corus’ technical qualifications and expand our technical programming to position LWR’s technical work. The position will be based in Janakpur, Nepal.

Education & Experience

The ideal candidate should have a Bachelor’s with at least 7 years’ experience in business administration, economics, agribusiness, agricultural economics or equivalent combination of education and experience; Master’s is desired.  

S/he should have experience managing private sector engagement, agribusiness development, market systems strengthening or market-oriented initiatives in development programs. Experience working with colleagues in a multicultural, multi-linguistic environment is needed.

The candidate should have proven track record of developing and maintaining strong working relationships with private sector entities, government stakeholders, and trade associations or networks. In addition, s/he should have demonstrated experience managing terms and conditions as well as other international donors. Experience working with local and/or US-based and international partners (NGO/FBO/CBOs, universities and other technical institutions) is desired.

3. TECHNICAL MANAGER-FOOD TECHNOLOGY – ID:3879398

Reporting to the Deputy Chief of Party, the Technical Manager (TM), Food Technology will be responsible for managing and coordinating technical activities in food technology, compliance with food safety and sanitary and phytosanitary standards (SPS), and enhancing cold chain systems, providing technical assistance to develop and grow the project and contribute to technical programming to position LWR’s technical work. The competencies required to be successful in this position also include theoretical and practical understanding of food technology approaches, and ability to manage activities across the project locations. The position will be based at Kathmandu, Nepal.

Education & Experience:

The ideal candidate should have a Bachelor’s degree with at least 5 years’ experience in food technology, food science, post-harvest technology or equivalent combination of education and experience; Master’s desired.  S/he should have experience in training and extension with farmers, farmer groups, and private sector entities, preferred. Experience working with colleagues in a multicultural, multi-linguistic environment. 

In addition, the candidate should have demonstrated experience managing terms and conditions as well as other international donors, desired. Proven track record of developing and maintaining strong working relationships with public and private sector. Experience working with US-based, international partners and or local (NGO/FBO/CBOs, universities and other technical institutions) is desired.

4. TECHNICAL MANAGER- TRAINING – ID:3883325

Reporting to the Deputy Chief of Party, the Technical Manager, Training is responsible for building the capacity and knowledge of farmers and value chain actors by managing and coordinating technical activities and providing technical assistance to develop and grow the project and contribute to technical programming to position LWR’s technical work. The competencies required to be successful in this position also include theoretical and practical understanding of adult training methodologies and approaches, the use of practical, hands-on learning and digital tools, and the ability to manage activities across the project locations. The position requires coordinating, contributing to, and supporting the technical implementation of training activities as well as providing technical inputs into project workplans, budgets, guidelines, training curricula, implementation tools, and reporting, and monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) in compliance with the requirements and regulations of the award. Duties include organizing and coordinating with the Chief of Party, Deputy Chief of Party, technical managers, sub-recipients, consultants, and headquarters or regional Technical Business Unit (TBU) staff. The position will be based in Janakpur, Nepal.

Education & Experience:

The ideal candidate should have a Bachelor’s with at least 5 years’ experience in social sciences, agriculture, aquaculture or equivalent combination of education and experience; Master’s desired. S/he should have experience working with colleagues in a multicultural, multi-linguistic environment. Proven experience in curriculum development, training of trainers (ToT), capacity building of adults, participatory training methodologies, and use of digital technologies to deliver training is required.  In addition, s/he should have proven track record of developing and maintaining strong working relationships with farmers, value chain actors, host country counterparts and NGO/FBO/CBO actors. Experience working with US-based and international partners and or local (NGO/FBO/CBOs, universities and other technical institutions is desirable.

description:
﻿﻿﻿﻿कर्मचारीहरूको आवश्यकता

सुरक्षित आप्रवासन (सामी) कार्यक्रम नेपाल सरकार र स्वीट्जरल्याण्ड सरकारको द्विपक्षीय पहल हो । यो कार्यक्रम संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय सरकारको साझेदारीमा कार्यान्यवन भइरहेको छ । कार्यक्रमलाई स्वीस सरकार विकास सहयोगको तर्फबाट हेल्भेटास नेपालले प्राविधिक सहयोग उपलब्ध गराइरहेको छ । यसै कार्यक्रम अन्तर्गत कर्णाली र सुदुरपश्चिम प्रदेशमा गरी जम्मा २ (दुई) जना हलुका सवारी चालकको आवश्यकता भएकाले तपशिल बमोजिमका योग्यता पुगेका इच्छुक नेपाली नागरिकहरूबाट सो पदका लागि आवेदन आह्वान गरिन्छ ।

परियोजनाको नामसुरक्षित आप्रवासन (सामी) कार्यक्रम
पदसवारी चालक
कार्यक्रम अवधि१५ जुलाई, २०२८
कार्य क्षेत्रकर्णाली (सुर्खेत) र सुदुरपश्चिम (धनगढी) प्रदेश
संख्या२ जना
योग्यता तथा कार्य अनुभव

न्यूनतम् एस.एल.सी. उत्तीर्ण गरेको ।

कम्तिमा ३ वर्ष विभिन्न पहाडी तथा तराई जिल्लाहरूमा सवारी चलाएको अनुभव भएको ।

हलुका सवारी चालक प्रमाण पत्र प्राप्त गरेको ।

डाक्टरद्वारा आँखा जाँच गरी सवारी साधन चलाउन योग्य भएको प्रमाण पत्र प्राप्त गरेको ।

मुख्य जिम्मेवारीहरू

कर्मचारी, सवारी साधन र अन्य सामाग्रीहरूको सुरक्षाको सम्पूर्ण जिम्मेवारी लिई सवारी चलाउने ।

हेल्भेटास नेपालको सवारी साधनको सम्पुर्ण नियमहरू पालन गर्ने ।

सवारी साधनको नियमित मर्मत तथा संम्भार (सर्भिसिङ्) तथा आवधिक जाँच (माइलेज, इन्धन खपत, मेसिनको अवस्था आदि) गरी सवारी साधनलाई सधैं राम्रो र गुड्ने अवस्थामा राख्ने ।  

फिल्डमा जाँदा कर्मचारीहरूलाई आवश्यकता अनुसार सहयोग गर्ने ।

तलब तथा अन्य सुविधाहेल्भेटास नेपालको नियमानुसार
बुझाउनु पर्ने कागजातहरू(१) निवेदन, (२) नागरिकताको फोटोकपी, (३) व्यक्तिगत विवरण (बायोडाटा), (४) शैक्षिक योग्यता तथा अनुभवको प्रमाण पत्र, (५) तालिमका प्रमाणपत्र, (६) निरोगिता तथा आँखाको जाँच गरी सवारी साधन चलाउन योग्य भएको प्रमाण पत्र, र (७) हलुका चारपाङ्ग्रे सवारी साधनको लागि अद्यावधिक गरिएको सवारी चालक अनुमतिपत्रको प्रतिलिपि

माथि उल्लेखित योग्यता तथा कार्य अनुभव भएका इच्छुक आवेदकहरूले सामी/हेल्भेटास नेपाल, धोबिघाट, ललितपुर, पो.ब. नं. ६८८, काठमाडौंको कार्यालयमा वा इमेलः sami.np@helvetas.org मार्फत आवेदन दिन सक्नेछन् । सम्बन्धित प्रादेशिक बासिन्दालाई बिशेष ग्राहयता दिइनेछ ।

प्रारम्भिक छनौटमा पर्न सफल आवेदकहरूलाई मात्र परीक्षा र अन्तरवार्ताको लागि सम्पर्क गरिनेछ । कृपया टेलिफोनबाट कुनै पनि प्रकारको सोधपुछ नगर्नुहोला । कुनै पनि आवेदन वा सम्पूर्ण आवेदनहरू अस्वीकार गर्ने अधिकार हेल्भेटास नेपालमा सुरक्षित रहने छ ।

हेल्भेटास नेपालले कर्मचारीमा विविधताको प्रवर्द्धन गर्दछ र विभेदित समूहहरू (महिला, दलित, जनजाति, मधेशी/तराई, अन्य अल्पसंख्यक समुदायहरू ) का उम्मेदवारहरूप्रति सकरात्मक विभेद लागु गर्दछ ।

आवेदन बुझाउने अन्तिम मितिः २०८२/०७/१४ (अक्टोबर ३१, २०२५) गते सम्म ।

﻿﻿Request for Sealed Quotation (RfQ)

for 

Supply of Agriculture Inputs for Lumbini Province of RAIN Programme

Local Initiatives for Biodiversity, Research and Development (LI-BIRD) is a non-profit, non-governmental organization established in October 1995 with its Head Office in Pokhara and Programme Coordination Office in Lalitpur. LI-BIRD is committed to capitalizing on local resources, innovations and institutions for the sustainable management of natural resources and building resilience to climate change for improving the livelihoods of target beneficiaries that includes smallholder farmers particularly women in Nepal.

LI-BIRD, with technical support from DCA, and PIN as a lead organization, is implementing a project entitled “RAIN-Resilience, Adaptation and Inclusion in Nepal”, in Madesh and Lumbini Provinces with the financial support of FCDO/BEK. 

Under the RAIN project, LI-BIRD has planned for the establishment of agroecological model village in Dang district (Lamahi Municipality) and Kapilvastu District (Banganga, Buddhabhumi, Shivaraj, and Kapilvastu Municipalities). Thus, LI-BIRD invites Request for Sealed Quotations from qualified, experienced, and legally registered vendors for the supply of agriculture inputs for Lumbini province of RAIN programme. The detail list and specification of the agriculture inputs are listed in the Request for Quotation Form. 

The interested vendors need to fill up the Request for Sealed Quotation(RfQ) Formwhich can be downloaded from the link below:

Download Request for Sealed Quotation (RfQ) Form & Tender Guarantee Form 

The interested vendors are requested to follow the following submisssion guidelines: 

  • The vendors must sign in each page of Request for Sealed Quotation Form in acceptance of the terms and conditions laid down in the form, failing which it will be presumed that the bidder is not willing to accept the terms and conditions of the tender and will be liable for rejection.
  • Interested vendors are requested to submit the Request for Sealed Quotation form along with the annexes including tender guarantee via hand delivery or courier to either of the following two locations: 

LI-BIRD Head Office

Pokhara-12, Kaski, Gandaki Province

Contact No.: 061-585357

LI-BIRD Programme Coordination Office

Sahachal, Sanepa-2, Lalitpur, Bagmati Province

Contact No.: 01-5440330

  • The subject line of the email must be entitled “Supply of Agriculture Inputs for Lumbini Province”.

The submission deadline is 19 October 2025 (Sunday), 5.00 pm. The quotation must be written in the English language. The quotation received after the deadline will not be entertained and considered for further evaluation. 

Note: Please fill in the vendor registration form for FY 2082/83 if you or your firm is not registered in LI-BIRD’s vendor roster. Refer to the following link for the Vendor Registration Form:

  • For Organization: https://hrp.libird.org/li-bird-vendor-registration?new=1

Quotations that do not meet the requirements will be discarded. Quotations that meet the requirements and offer the best value for money will be considered for the further evaluation process. LI-BIRD reserves the right to accept or reject, wholly or partly any or all the bids without assigning any reason whatsoever. All the costs associated with preparing and submitting the quotation shall be borne solely by the companies. 

The programme will ensure that funds are used solely for their intended purposes and will apply due diligence to verify that bidders can deliver activities impartially and in line with programme objectives; vendors with potential conflicts of interest or affiliations that could affect fair implementation will not be considered.

description:
﻿﻿﻿Communication Officer

Job posted on Oct 14 2025                                                                         

Vacancy Announcement

Shangri-La Development Association (SDA) is a non-government, not-for-profit organization established by Youths for community development in 2014 A.D. SDA has been making community interventions since the inception of the organization. To date, SDA has conducted Shangri-La Sustainable Local Initiative Project (SSLI, SSLI-I, SSLI-II, SSLI-III, SSLI-IV,), School Building Reconstruction and Education Support Project (SBRES), Shangri-La Reconstruction and Development Project (SRDP) and One Time Support Project (OTSP). All the other projects done were incorporated in such a way that it supports the SSLI project and strengthens the interventions.

Shangri-La Sustainable Local Initiative Project 5 (SSLI5) is a three-year project of the Shangri-La Association (SA), Switzerland / Govinda Association (GA), Germany, and SDA. The target project areas are Karnali Higher Secondary School, Anamnagar, Jumla, and Kailash Rural Municipality of Makwanpur district. SSLI primarily targets three wards of Kailash Rural Municipality in Makwanpur. Apart from these, 40 deaf children in Jumla are the targeted beneficiaries through Jumla Special Children Project (JSCP). These children come from all over Karnali Region as the school with the support of SDA has the best possible facilities and support.

Application Deadline: 5:00 PM, 29th October 2025

Position: Communication Officer

Location: Lalitpur

Period of Employment: 1 year (with possibility of extension)

Gross Salary: NPR 40,000–45,000 per month

Reports to: Coordinator

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media

  • Coordinate and communicate with the field and head office team to stay up-to-date on project activities and collect materials for regular social media posts and blogs.
  • Share regular updates on organization’s project activities on social media platforms, including post design and text content.
  • Write and share blog posts through the organization’s website on different project activities, notable achievements, and human’s interest stories based out of the project regions.
  • Ensure that the organization’s website and social media platforms are up-to-date and the content remains relevant.

2. Support and Documentation

  • In accordance with guidelines from supervisor and partner organizations, maintain a social media database including archives of all social media posts, communication materials like print materials (brochures, booklets), as well as other reference materials such as One-Pagers and news publications about the organization.
  • Support and assist the partner organizations in fundraising in an impactful way by collecting information and developing communication materials as and when requested.
  • Provide editorial support by reviewing reports and other written outputs as needed to ensure clarity, coherence, and high-quality communication

3. Policy and Branding Guideline Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to Branding Guidelines in the design of all communication materials including social media posts and other printing materials.
  • Guide and monitor the team to ensure compliance with the Social Media Policy’s.
  • Guide and monitor the team to ensure compliance with the Branding Guidelines in any outward-facing communication materials that may be independently developed by the team such as event banners.

4. Miscellaneous

  • Regular field visits to the project location in Kailash Rural Municipality, Makwanpur are expected to gather materials for social media content and maintain up-to-date information on ongoing project activities.
  • The Communication Officer is expected to develop a deep familiarity with SDA’s history, projects, and impacts in order to develop impactful and original content over time.
  • The Communication Officer may be required to organize virtual events for donor engagement in coordination with partner organizations.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, or a related field with at least 2 years of relevant experience; 

OR

  • Master’s degree in a related field with at least 1 year of relevant experience.
  • Strong skills in content creation, editing, and communication strategy.
  • Proficiency in digital communication tools and social media platforms.
  • Experience in event coordination and stakeholder engagement is an advantage.
  • Excellent interpersonal, coordination, and teamwork abilities.

Notes:

Women, person with disabilities, and people who identify as belonging to marginalized communities and excluded population are strongly encouraged to apply for the position. Depending on the condition and requirement of the candidate, accommodation facilities will be manageable.

SDA follows a zero-tolerance policy towards sexual exploitation and misconduct, sexual harassments, and abuse of authority, and corruption. All candidates will, therefore undergo rigorous background check. All candidates applying for the post are expected to forward three (3) references and will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles.

SDA is committed to being an equal opportunity and inclusive employer, free from discrimination based on race, sex, gender identity, religion, nationality, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, age, language, social origin, or any other protected status.

We treat all applications for employment fairly, regardless of gender, race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, caste, tribe, belief, age, marital status, pregnancy, caring responsibilities, sexual orientation, or disability.

Shangri-La Development Association is committed to safeguarding and protecting children and vulnerable adults, and candidates will be subject to pre-employment checks including criminal checks and terrorist financing. To ensure that SDA meets its obligations of safer recruitment, appointment to positions within Shangri-La Development Association will be subject to a satisfactory criminal check. Criminal checks will be conducted for all roles.

Please answer the following questions and submit your responses along with the application documents. Applications without responses to these questions won’t be accepted.

https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1XCIxGPLHOKUBui-Jaq5kWWssmb4gS6Pp

HOW TO APPLY:

Interested candidates are required to submit their Cover Letter, Curriculum Vitae (CV), and any other relevant documents to hr@sdanepal.org by 5:00 PM, 29 October 2025. Shortlisted candidates will be required to provide an updated police clearance report. 

Contact Number: 015230003

﻿﻿Job Title: HR Generalist

Department: Human Resources

Reports To: HR Manager / Head of HR

Location: Jawalakhel, Lalitpur

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary:

The HR Generalist will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operations of the Human Resources department. This position is responsible for managing various HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, benefits administration, compliance, and HR policy implementation. The ideal candidate is people-oriented, well-organized, and has a strong understanding of employment laws and best HR practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Employee Records & Compliance: Maintain accurate employee records and ensure compliance with labor laws, regulations, and company policies.
  • Policy Development: Assist in developing, implementing, and updating HR policies and procedures.
  • Benefits & Payroll Support: Support benefits administration, payroll coordination, and employee data management.
  • Training & Development: Coordinate training and development programs to enhance employee skills, performance, and engagement.
  • Performance Management: Assist in performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, and feedback initiatives.
  • HR Reporting & Analytics: Prepare and maintain HR reports and metrics to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Employee Relations: Act as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, addressing inquiries and concerns effectively.
  • Culture & Engagement: Foster a positive, inclusive, and compliant workplace culture through proactive employee relations and engagement initiatives.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 1-2 years of experience in a similar HR role; BPO and call center industry experience is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in MS Office Suite and HRIS systems.
  • Familiarity with HR analytics and data-driven decision making.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with professionalism.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture.
  • Exposure to a wide range of HR functions and strategic initiatives.

Sub-Contracting on Early Actions Relevant to Resilience/Adaptation at Lumbini Province of RAIN Programme

Local Initiatives for Biodiversity, Research and Development (LI-BIRD) is a non-profit, non-governmental organization established in October 1995 with its Head Office in Pokhara and Programme Coordination Office in Lalitpur. LI-BIRD is committed to capitalizing on local resources, innovations and institutions for the sustainable management of natural resources and building resilience to climate change for improving the livelihoods of target beneficiaries that includes smallholder farmers particularly women in Nepal.

LI-BIRD, with technical support from DCA, and PIN as a lead organization, is implementing a project entitled “RAIN-Resilience, Adaptation and Inclusion in Nepal”, in Madesh and Lumbini Provinces with the financial support of FCDO/BEK.

Under the RAIN project, LI-BIRD has planned for the sub-contracting on early actions relevant to resilience/adaptation in the targeted core palikas of Lumbini province of RAIN programme. Thus, LI-BIRD invites Request for Proposals from qualified, experienced, and legally registered contractors for the sub-contracting on early actions relevant to resilience/adaptation in the targeted core palikas of Lumbini province (Kapilvastu & Maharajgunj Municipality) of RAIN programme.

The interested companies need to fill up the Request for Proposals (RfP) Form which can be downloaded from the link listed below:

Download Request for Proposal Forms & Tender Guarantee Form

The interested applicants are requested to follow the following submisssion guidelines: 

  • The applicants must sign in each page of Request for Proposal Form in acceptance of the terms and conditions laid down in the form, failing which it will be presumed that the bidder is not willing to accept the terms and conditions of the tender and will be liable for rejection. 
  • Interested applicants are requested to submit the Request for Proposal form along with the annexes including tender guarantee via email to procurement@libird.org The subject line of the email must be entitled “RfP for Sub-Contracting at Lumbini Province”.
  • Interested applicants may submit one, two, three or all four RfPs for the sub-contracting schemes.

The submission deadline is 19 October 2025 (Sunday), 5.00 pm. The proposal must be written in the English language. The proposal received after the deadline will not be entertained and considered for further evaluation.

Note: Please fill in the vendor registration form for FY 2082/83 if you or your firm is not registered in LI-BIRD’s vendor roster. Refer to the following link for the Vendor Registration Form:

  • For Organization: https://hrp.libird.org/li-bird-vendor-registration?new=1

A proposal that does not meet the requirements will be discarded. Proposals that meet the requirements and offer the best value for money will be considered for the further evaluation process. LI-BIRD reserves the right to accept or reject, wholly or partly any or all the bids without assigning any reason whatsoever. All the costs associated with preparing and submitting the letter of interest and proposal shall be borne solely by the companies.

The programme will ensure that funds are used solely for their intended purposes and will apply due diligence to verify that bidders can deliver activities impartially and in line with programme objectives; vendors with potential conflicts of interest or affiliations that could affect fair implementation will not be considered.

description:
﻿﻿ग्रामीण महिला उत्थान संघ (RWUA)

पदपूर्तिका लागि आवेदन

प्रकाशन मितिः १३ अक्टोबर २०२५

परिचयः ग्रामीण नारी उत्थान संघले २०५० साल देखि सर्लाही जिल्ला र केही बाहिरका जिल्लाहरूमा महिला सशक्तिकरण, नागरिक अधिकार, स्वावलम्बन, सुशासन, शान्ति र समावेशीकरण, प्रकोप व्यवस्थापन तथा जोखिम न्युनिकरण, लैङ्गिक समता, दिगो कृषि, जीविकोपार्जन, बाल अधिकार, बाल शिक्षा र बाल स्वास्थ्य सम्बन्धी कार्यक्रमहरूका साथै जनसरोकारका सवालहरुमा काम गर्दै आएको एक गैर–सरकारी र गैर–नाफामुखी सामाजिक संस्था हो । 

सर्लाही जिल्लामा महिला सशक्तिकरण र सामुदायिक विकासको क्षेत्रमा परिवर्तनको एजेन्टको रूपमा काम गर्दछ। सामुदायिक विकास र महिला उत्थानको क्षेत्रमा लामो समयदेखिका अनुभवहरूले संस्थालाई विगत ३३ वर्षदेखि समुदायलाई आफ्नो भन्दा सकारात्मक परिवर्तनका लागि संगठित गर्न सजिलो बनाएको छ । यो महिला नेतृत्वको संस्था हो र अधिकांश कार्यकारी सदस्यहरू महिला छन् । यसले आर्थिक, सामाजिक, सांस्कृतिक र भौतिक रूपान्तरण मार्फत मानिसहरूको जीवन सुधार गर्ने लक्ष्यका साथ काम गर्दछ । यसले विभिन्न संघ संस्थाहरूको साझेदारीमा सर्लाही जिल्लामा धेरै परियोजनाहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्दै आएको छ ।

यसै सन्दर्भमा सर्लाही जिल्लामा सेभ द चिल्ड्रेन पार्टनरशिप (समुन्नती) परियोजना अन्तर्गत तल उल्लेखित पदको लागि RWUA ले इच्छुक, योग्य र योग्य उम्मेदवारहरू (नेपाली नागरिकहरू मात्र) बाट आवेदन आमन्त्रित गर्दछ जो भरपर्दो, जवाफदेही छन्, र उच्चतम स्तरको ईमानदारीका साथ परिणामहरू प्रदान गर्न सक्षम छन् ।

कार्य विवरण पदको शीर्षकः कृषि प्राविधिक सहायक (JTA)

कार्यालय ठेगानाः ग्रामीण नारी उत्थान संघ, हरिपुर

सुपरिवेक्षकः फिल्ड संयोजक – बाल सम्वेदनशील जीविकोपार्जन

प्रतिवेदन बुझाउने: फिल्ड संयोजक

सुपरिवेक्षण गरिएकोः छैन/छ

कार्यक्षेत्रः सर्लाही जिल्लाको हरिपुर र ईश्वरपुर नगरपालिकामा कार्यरत समुन्नती कार्यक्रम

बाल सुरक्षा नीतिः

उम्मेद्वार नेपाल सरकार तथा संस्थागत शुन्य सहनशीलता, सुरक्षा तथा बाल संरक्षण नीतिलाई हस्ताक्षर गरी पालना गर्नुपर्नेछ र कुनै पनि बाल संलग्नताको समयमा “दुई वयस्क“ नियम कायम राख्नुपर्छ ।

कार्यको विस्तृत विवरण 

कृषि प्राविधिक सहायक (JTA) समुन्नति कार्यक्रम अन्तर्गत लक्षित क्षेत्रहरूमा कृषि उत्पादन, जीविकोपार्जन पहलहरू, र आय आर्जन (IG) समूहहरूलाई सहयोग गर्ने जिम्मेवारी भएको र सो सहयोगको आधारमा कृषकहरुको घरायसी आयमा सुधार गर्ने, गरिबी न्युनीकरण र सामुदायिक लचिलोपनलाई बलियो बनाउन समुदाय परिचालन, प्राविधिक सहयोग, र बजार सम्बन्धहरूलाई सहज बनाउनेछ।

JTA ले समुन्नति कार्यक्रम, RWUA र समुदाय बीच एक प्रमुख मध्यस्थताको रूपमा काम गर्दछ, कृषिमा (जलवायु स्मार्ट कृषि), कृषि उद्यमशीलता (लघु उद्यम र व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण), र स्थानीय सरकारसँग सेवा सुविधा, लक्षित लाभार्थीहरूको लागि संयुक्त पहलहरू, र जलवायु–अनुकूलन हस्तक्षेपहरूको लागि पैरवी/वकालत सुनिश्चित गर्ने ।

प्रमुख जिम्मेवारीहरू

१. जीविकोपार्जन र कृषि क्षेत्रमा सहयोग

  • दैनिक कृषि समुहमा र उद्यमशील समूहहरूलाई नियमित प्राविधिक सहयोग (उच्च–मूल्य कृषि वस्तु) र तत्काल समर्थन प्रदान गर्ने ।
  • उत्पादकता बढाउनका लागि आधुनिक जलवायु मैत्री कृषि प्रविधि बारे अभिमुखिकरण तथा राम्रा अभ्यासहरूको प्रस्तुतीकरण गर्ने ।
  • किसानहरू द्वारा उत्पादनभएका वस्तुहरुको उचित मूल्य सुनिश्चित गर्न स्थानीयतह तथा थोक बजार संग समन्वय गरी सहज वातावरण निर्माण गर्ने ।
  • उद्यमीहरू बाट छनौट गरिएको लघु उद्यमका योजनाहरू तयार गरी कार्यान्वयनका विभिन्न लघु उद्यमीहरुलाई सहयोग गर्ने ।

२. सामुदायिक परिचालन र सरोकारवाला संलग्नता

  • गरिबी न्युनीकरण, जीविकोपार्जन र स्थानीयतहको प्रणाली सुदृढीकरणका लागि समुदायमा तथा स्थानीय सरोकारवालाहरु संग कृषि उत्पादन तथा व्यवस्थापनका लागि सामुदायिक बैठकहरू/अन्र्तक्रिया कार्यक्रमहरू सञ्चालन गर्ने ।
  • त्रैमासिक संयुक्त अनुगमन भ्रमणहरू सञ्चालन गरी वडा, नगरपालिका, कृषि कार्यालयहरू र सहकारीहरूसँग सम्बन्ध विस्तार तथा सहकार्य गर्ने ।
  • कार्यक्रमको एकीकृत प्रभावीकरणको लागि युवा सञ्जाल, CSOs, र जलवायु सुधारका समुहरू सँग सम्बन्ध निर्माण गर्ने ।
  • कृषि क्षेत्रमा प्राविधिक दक्षता र उत्पादनकनको गुणस्तर वृद्घि र विकासका लागि स्थानीय स्रोत व्यक्तिहरू अनुगमन तथा मुल्याङ्कनको लागि समन्वय गर्ने  ।

३. कार्यक्षेत्र , प्रतिवेदन र दस्तावेजीकरण

  • मासिक, अर्धवार्षिक र वार्षिक प्रगति प्रतिवेदनहरू समयमै तयार गर्ने ।
  • प्राविधिक माध्यम(कोबो, पूर्व/पोस्ट–टेस्ट, प्रतिक्रिया फारमहरू) प्रयोग गरेर तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरी र दस्तावेजीकरण गर्ने ।
  • प्रत्येक महिनामा कार्यक्रमका उपलब्धिहरूको आधारमा प्रत्येक महिना दुई वटा केस/सफलता कथाहरू तयार गर्ने ।

४. कार्यक्रमको गुणस्तर र उत्तरदायित्व

  • वितरण गरेका सामग्रीहरू, र सेवाहरूको  १००% गुणस्तर सुनिश्चित गर्ने ।
  • स्रोतको प्रयोग, ज्ञान, प्राविधिक विशेषज्ञता, बजेट र किसान र स्थानीय स्रोत व्यक्तिहरूको क्षमता सुदृढीकरणको लागि नगरपालिकाको सम्बन्धित इकाई र कृषि ज्ञान केन्द्रसँग समन्वय गर्ने ।
  • सबै क्षेत्र गतिविधिहरूमा गुणस्तरको मापदण्ड (QBMs) को अनुपालन कायम राख्ने ।
  • दिगोपन सुनिश्चित गर्न स्थानीय सामुदायिक उत्पादनहरूको लागि मूल्य श्रृंखला विकासलाई प्रवद्र्धन गर्ने ।

५. बाल सुरक्षा तथा संरक्षण 

  • बालबालिकाको बाल सुरक्षा र संरक्षण नीतिहरू सधैं पालना गर्ने ।
  • नीति अनुसार बाल सुरक्षा सम्बन्धि भएका घटनाहरू बाल सुरक्षा सम्पर्क व्यक्तिलाई जानकारी गराउने ।
  • सबै गतिविधि स्थानहरूमा बाल संरक्षण नीति र आचार संहिता र शून्य सहनशीलताको प्रस्तुतीकरण गर्ने ।
  • “हानि नगरौ”का सिद्धान्तलाई परियोजनाको कार्यक्रमहरूमा कार्यान्वयन गर्ने ।

६. योग्यता र सीपहरू

  • JTA वा बाली विज्ञान डिप्लोमा गरेको । 
  • जीविकोपार्जन, विपद् जोखिम न्यूनीकरण र सामुदायिक विकासमा २ वर्षको अनुभव।
  • विविध समुह, समुदायहरू तथा सांस्कृतिक संवेदनशीलतासँग प्रभावकारी रूपमा काम गर्ने क्षमता भएको ।
  • स्थानीय भाषामा सञ्चार सीप साथै सहजीकरण, सञ्चार र सहभागितामूलक दृष्टिकोण भएको 
  • प्रतिवेदन लेखन, दस्तावेजीकरण, र डिजिटल उपकरणहरू (MS Office, KOBO tools, इमेल, र इन्टरनेट) मा दक्षता भएको ।
  • नेपाली र अंग्रेजी (बोल्ने/लिखित)मा राम्रो ज्ञान ।
  • दुई पाङ्ग्रे सवारी साधन र सवारीचालक अनुमतिपत्र भएको हुनुपर्ने ।

७. अपेक्षित उपलब्धिहरू (मापनयोग्य आउटपुटहरू)

  • प्रति महिना २ वटा सफलताको कथाहरू समयमै पेश गर्ने ।
  • मासिक, त्रैमासिक रिपोर्ट, अर्ध–वार्षिक र वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन तयार गर्ने ।
  • आवश्यक्ताको आधारमा स्थानीय वा  सरोकारवाला अनुगमन र अवलोकन सञ्चालन गर्ने ।

Organization Background

iDE is a global team of more than 1,000 changemakers coming from diverse backgrounds within international development and the private sector. What we all have in common is the belief that one entrepreneur can change their community, and millions can change the world. When Paul Polak founded International Development Enterprises (iDE) in 1982, his idea that business was the solution to poverty was new and untested. Over forty years later, Paul’s concept has been proven not only by iDE but also by the increasing number of established and new organizations that have embraced this approach.

Our work stands out in the international development arena. We are driven to end poverty but do not provide handouts of supplies or cash. Instead, we believe that everyone has the ability to increase their livelihoods and build long-term resilience by their own accord. They may just need training or connections to suppliers and customers. That’s where we come in and what we mean when we say we are 'powering entrepreneurs to end poverty.'

Project Background

AgriPath is a multi-country research and implementation consortium led by the University of Bern, with partners including Grameen Foundation USA, Grameen Foundation India, ICIPE, FarmBetter, Kilimo Trust, SEMUS, and iDE Nepal. The project aims to support 150,000 smallholder farmers (30–50% women) to increase productivity, income, and climate resilience through the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices via digitally supported agricultural advisory services (DAS).In Nepal, iDE leads implementation and requires branded merchandise to ensure effective visibility and professional presentation across all training programs, workshops, and community events.

 Background

The Oxford University Clinical Research Unit (OUCRU) is a large-scale clinical and public health research unit, with sites offices in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi in Vietnam, Jakarta in Indonesia and Kathmandu in Nepal. 

OUCRU Nepal’s mission is to have a local, regional and global impact on health by leading a locally driven research programme on infectious diseases. Please see more information on OUCRU website: www.oucru.org

Purpose of the job position
The Data Associate will work under the supervision of the Data Management Officer to support the development, implementation, and management of data systems for research studies. This role will support the research team in achieving high-quality, accurate and reliable results.
Key responsibilities and tasks

Key responsibilities and tasks:

Data Handling and Management

  • Assist in designing and maintaining data acquisition tools for research studies.
  • Help maintain data integrity, accuracy and completeness by performing data-related tasks such as flagging inconsistencies or missing information.
  • Support the verification and cleaning of research data.
  • Help ensure data is collected in line with ethical standards and study guidelines.
  • Assist in applying data validation rules and edit checks within Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems. 

Quality Control

  • Conduct routine data audits and follow up with study teams to resolve issues.
  • Generate and update tables and charts of the indicators of interest for routine monitoring purposes.
  • Raise and track data queries in the database for discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies in the collected data.

Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Prepare datasets for analysis through data cleaning and transformation.
  • Collaborate with research team to perform basic statistical analysis
  • Assist in preparing regular and ad-hoc reports.

Documentation and Record Keeping

  • Assist in documentation of data management processes including user access, and query resolution.
  • Assist in preparation of relevant data management documents including data management plans, standard operating procedure and guidelines.

Research Support Activities

  • Extract patient health record data from multiple healthcare providers.
  • Monitor and manage data collected from digital surveillance tools (e.g., ChatSci), if required.
  • Assist enumerators in administering structured questionnaires to patients at different community healthcare providers.


Requirements

Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Health Science, Health Informatics or a related field

Experience:

  • At least 1-year experience in related field

Other requirements:

  • Experience in working on Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems such as REDCap.
  • Experience in working in statistical analytical tools such as SPSS.
  • Experience in working with large health-related datasets
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft tools.

Subi Prajapati, Sr. HR Officer

description:
﻿﻿Centre for Development and Disaster Management (CDM-Nepal)

Bhairahawa, Rupandehi

Terms of Reference (TOR)

 For

 Conducting Household Survey for Disaster Risk–informed Planning in Sammarimai Rural Municipality of Rupandehi District in Lumbini Province


३.२.३ विपद् जोखिम डाटा सँग सम्बन्घित घरधुरी सर्वेक्षण गरि तथ्यांक सकंलन गर्ने, सरोकारवाला सँग गोष्ठी 

General Background

﻿﻿﻿ CDM-Nepal is a national non-governmental development and humanitarian organization having Head Quarter in Butwal, Lumbini Province, Nepal. Established in 2000 in Rupandehi, CDM-Nepal has worked in disaster risk reduction, climate action, water sanitation and hygiene promotion, livelihoods and gender equity and social inclusion including gender-based violence. CDM’s target beneficiaries include marginalized women, children, youth and vulnerable communities. CDM worked in Rupandehi, Nawalparasi, Kapilvastu, Arghakhachi, Gulmi, Palpa, Okhaldhunga, Doti, Dadeldhura, Baitadi, Kathmandu and Achham Districts.

CDM-Nepal was registered with the District Administration Office of Rupandehi in 16 May 2000 with registration number 466-057/058. It is affiliated with the Social Welfare Council of Nepal Government in 2000 with registration number 11639/057. Since its establishment, it has become a member of NGO Federation Nepal, National Disaster Preparedness Network (DPNet) Nepal since 2008 and a founding member of National Network of Community Disaster and Climate Risk Management Committee (NCDMC). District Disaster Management Committee (DDMC) of Rupandehi district has selected CDM-Nepal as the current District Lead Support Agency (DLSA) of Rupandehi district. Since 2017, CDM-Nepal has been providing technical and other support to the Lumbini Provincial Government as the Province Lead Support Agency (PLSA).

CDM Nepal has invited eligible individuals with relevant experiences to submit proposals, as Sammarimai Rural Municipality faces a high risk of disasters, including floods and other natural hazards. To mitigate these risks and develop an effective disaster preparedness and response plan, it is critical to understand the vulnerabilities and capacities of the local population. Therefore, CDM Nepal seeks to hire a qualified consultancy firm to conduct a comprehensive household survey and mapping of disaster-affected areas across three wards of Sammarimai Rural Municipality (wards 3, 5, and 7).

Sammarimai Rural Municipality has 7,242 households. Among them, Ward No. 3 has 1,257 households, Ward No. 5 has 1,150 households, and Ward No. 7 has 1,075 households. According to data provided by Sammarimai Rural Municipality, the total number of disaster risk households in these three wards is 3,482.


Objectives of the Assignment:

The objectives of this ToR is build capacity of the municipality to respond to emergencies through; 1) Identifying disaster prone communities conducting household survey for disaster risk-informed planning. Household survey will focus on flood prone wards especially wards 3, 5, and 7 within the municipality. Specific objectives include:

  • To collect household-level disaster risk data with a focus disaster risks, vulnerabilities, and capacities.

  • To map out disaster-affected communities within the rural municipality.

  • To analyze data and provide recommendations for disaster risk reduction (DRR) planning and interventions.

Scope of Services and Tasks and Activities to be completed:

The overall scope of this assignment for a consultant /consulting firm include facilitating survey process, identify Red, Yellow and Green HHs. This information shall be used for preparedness work. Specific objectives include: 

–      Designing a survey methodology and data collection tools tailored to assess disaster risks, vulnerabilities, and capacities.

–      Facilitate conducting household-level survey of all 3, 5 and 7 wards of Sammarimai Rural Municipality.

–      Collecting GPS-based data to map disaster-affected areas.

–      Ensuring data quality through proper training of enumerators and supervision during the data collection process.

–      Analyzing the collected data to identify vulnerabilities, and risk-prone families.

–      Preparing a comprehensive report with actionable recommendations for households located in Red, Yellow and Green zones for enhancing disaster risk reduction initiatives.

 

Location of the assignment:  Sammarimai Rural Municipalities (wards 3, 5 and 7) of Rupandehi District. 

Outputs/Deliverables

The following deliverables are expected from the consultant in due process of the assignment:

1.      Inception report detailing the survey methodology, tools, and work plan.

2.      Orientation to enumerators and field team members on data collection techniques supported by submission of the orientation report.

3.     Cleaned and verified dataset from the household survey.

4.     GIS-based maps highlighting disaster-affected and high-risk areas.

5.     Final report with key findings, analysis, and recommendations.


Reporting Line

The consultant will report to CDM's Program Manager of the CRP III programme of CDM Nepal.


Proposal Submission 

Individual consultant /VAT registered consulting firm should submit the technical and financial proposal to CDM Nepal, Bhairahawa, by 17th October 2025, before 24 hrs (Nepali time) via e-mail to info@cdmnepal.org, clearly mentioning the title of the assignment in the subject line “Conducting Disaster Risk Household Survey.”

In line with the project objective for resilient income generation, the project will help micro entrepreneurs to start up and revive their businesses. 

 

 

Objectives of the Assignment:

The objective of this assignment is to impart knowledge and skills to local youth entrepreneurs to make them self-reliant by strengthening/establishing own enterprises through improving their business skills. Specific objective include:

·      Facilitate the “Start and Improve Your Business (SIYB)” training based on the standard of the International Labour Organisation (ILO) manual for training participants.

·      Support each youth entrepreneur to develop their Individual Business Plan to establish/strengthen micro enterprises 

·      To monitor and coach /support for further strengthening their enterprises based on their individual business plan 

 

Scope of Services, Tasks, and Activities to be completed:

The overall scope of this assignment is to hire a consultant to facilitate the ILO certified entrepreneurship development training called “Start and Improve Your Business-SIYB”. Activities will include, but may not be limited to, the following: 

–      Preparation for the sessions, resources and submission of the session plan to CDM Nepal prior to the training by 15 October 2025.

–      Develop pre and post-test evaluation questionnaires and submit comparative report for all participants. 

–      Facilitate the training as lead facilitator in all 3 places in October and early November 2025.

–      Facilitate each individual for the development of Individual Business Plan before providing them with necessary material and motivation support by 15 November 2025

–      Monitor participants performance and recommend for material support by 20th November 2025

 

Location of the assignment: The training will be conducted in Sammarimai, Marchawari, and Siyari Rural Municipalities at their respective local venues.


Outputs/Deliverables

The following deliverables are expected from the consultant in due process of the assignment:

–      Submission of training plan including detailed course content that will be focused on green jobs prior to training program.

–      Submit pre and post-test evaluation questionnaires for review by CDM staff 

–      Submit comparative report (pre vs posttest) for all participants. 

–      Prepare and submit training completion reports by October or early November 2025. 

–      Provide follow up support and ensure each trainee develops and submits Individual Business Plan by 15 November 2025

–      Recommendation report based on performance of the trainee for material support by 20th November 2025

 

Reporting Line

The consultant will report to CDM's Program Manager of the CRP III programme of CDM Nepal.


Proposal submission

Interested & eligible individuals /companies are invited to submit their technical proposal including letter of interest, profiles/relevant experiences, CVs and a financial proposal, including facilitation cost and associated costs of the training by 16th October 2024 (by 24 hours)  via email: info@cdmnepal.org with the subject line “Trainer for SIYB Training”. name: Action For Nepal
description:
﻿﻿﻿﻿Terms of Reference (ToR)

Appointment of External Auditor for FY 82/83

Background:

Action for Nepal (AF Nepal), a non-profit organization dedicated to fostering development in Nepal’s remote communities, has partnered with the Australian Himalayan Foundation (AHF) to promote health, education, and local empowerment in the Solukhumbu and Bajhang districts. Over the past nine years, AF Nepal has focused on improving maternal and child health by enhancing access to and utilization of healthcare resources. These efforts align with Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 3, which seeks to ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.

The regions where AF Nepal operates are prone to disasters. To address these risks, incorporating Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) training into ward-level activities is critical. Such training is also a requirement of the Minimum Service Standards (MSS) for health posts, which mandate disaster reduction orientation for health workers every six months. To ensure sustainability, AF Nepal plans to develop local-level trainers, including ward chairs, health post in-charges, health section, and DRR focal persons at the municipal and rural municipal levels. These trainers will facilitate ongoing orientations and establish ward-level DRR committees to strengthen local capacity for disaster preparedness and risk reduction.

1. Scope of Audit

The audit shall cover all aspects of Action for Nepal’s projects, including Finance, Procurement, Asset Management, Cash Management, Human Resources, and General Administration, and identify key issues and areas for improvement.

2. Process

2.1. The auditor shall consider the directives issued generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) to the extent applicable and the Nepal Accounting Standards for NPOs (NAS for NPOs) issued by Accounting Standard Board of Nepal.

2.2. The auditor shall visit the Action for Nepal Central Office, Boudha, Kathmandu, for conducting the audit.

2.3. Action for Nepal will provide project/donor-wise, Income and Expenditure Statements, Trial Balances, Bank Reconciliation Statements, Bills and Vouchers, Books of Accounts, and all other necessary documents and information during the audit.

2.4. Prior to the commencement of the audit, the auditors shall consult with Action for Nepal’s Executive Committee (EC) representatives and management to share the audit plan and other related matters.

A meeting shall be held between the auditors and management before starting the Project Statutory/External Audit, followed by another meeting before submission of the report.

2.5. The auditor must submit the CV and Company Profile with legal documents of the principal auditor (who will sign the report), along with CVs of the Managers, Supervisors, and key personnel proposed for the audit team. The CVs should include relevant audit experience and ongoing assignments, demonstrating capability and capacity to undertake the audit of Action for Nepal.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Technical Proposal including:
    • Description of how the firm’s experience and expertise meet the ToR requirements
    • Proposed audit methodology
  • Financial Proposal, including a detailed budget breakdown
  • CVs of the Principal Auditor and key team members
  • Profile of the Consultancy Firm
  • Certificate of Practice (COP) with current renewal
  • Firm Registration Certificate (ICAN)
  • Company Registration and VAT Registration Certificates
  • Latest Tax Clearance Certificate
  • Minimum 10 years of firm establishment and at least 5 years of experience in the development sector

3. Examination

3.1. The auditor shall perform detailed checks of bills, vouchers, and related procedures to assess and recommend improvements for internal control, procurement, financial management, and personnel policies.

3.2. The auditor shall conduct a general assessment of controls, ensuring:

  • Costs are actually incurred, identifiable, and verifiable
  • Expenses comply with applicable laws, donor requirements, accounting standards, and organizational policies
  • Costs are incurred within the respective fiscal year for statutory and tax purposes
  • All expenses are appropriately recorded in Action for Nepal’s books of accounts and those of implementing partners
  • Accounting records are accurate and adequate

3.3. The auditor shall perform a physical verification of materials, inventories, and fixed assets. Where required, Action for Nepal staff may assist with the count.

3.4. The auditor shall test whether Action for Nepal’s operations comply with applicable national laws and donor conditions.

4. Confidentiality

4.1. The auditor shall not, directly or indirectly, divulge or use any confidential information of Action for Nepal without prior written consent.

4.2. Auditors must maintain strict confidentiality of all information obtained during and after the audit to protect Action for Nepal from any potential harm caused by disclosure.

4.3. The auditor shall have full access to all records, including books of accounts, legal agreements, meeting minutes, bank statements, invoices, and employee contracts, and may contact relevant banks, consultants, contractors, or firms as required.

5. Liability and Independence

5.1. The auditor must be impartial and completely independent of Action for Nepal’s management or financial interests. Auditors must not be employed by, or have any financial or business relationship with, Action for Nepal or its senior staff during the audit period.

5.2. Action for Nepal shall have no control over the methods used by the auditor in performing the audit.

5.3. The auditor shall bear all legal and financial liabilities arising from claims of personal injury, economic harm, or other issues before, during, or after the audit

6. Audit Working Papers

6.1. The auditor shall retain audit working papers for seven years after the audit’s completion or longer if requested in writing by Action for Nepal.

6.2. Action for Nepal may request access to audit programs and working papers, which the auditor must provide upon request.

7. Audit Timeframe

Audit ProcedureApprox. Date
Entry Meeting/Understanding the business/audit period/financial review/report compilation/exit meeting15 August to 28 September 2026

8. Execution and Reporting

8.1. Audit findings shall be presented and shared immediately after completion for management responses.

8.2. The auditor shall present audit observations before finalizing the report and management letter at the Action for Nepal Central Office.

  • Draft Consolidated Report:
  • Final Report and Financials:

8.3. The Management Letter should include recommendations for improving internal controls, safeguarding assets, ensuring adequate documentation, reducing cash payments, managing advances, and enhancing authorization and stock control procedures.

8.4. The auditor may also highlight good practices observed within Action for Nepal and its implementing partners.

8.5. Financial Scope (approximate):

ParticularsPeriod Approx.Amount
Turnover of the organization17 July 2025 to 16 July 2026NPR 70 million

9. Payment Modality

100% payment will be made after submission and approval of the final audit report by the audit firm.

10. Consequences of Non-Compliance and Termination

The selected audit firm is expected to strictly adhere to the agreed Terms of Reference, professional auditing standards, and the timeline specified in the contract. Failure to comply with these requirements may result in the following actions:

  • Written Warning: In case of minor non-compliance or delays, the organization may issue a formal notice requesting immediate corrective action.
  • Termination of Contract: If the auditor fails to address issues within the stipulated time, or if there is serious negligence, misconduct, conflict of interest, breach of confidentiality, or violation of professional standards, the organization reserves the right to terminate the contract immediately.
  • Withholding of Payment: The organization may withhold all or part of the agreed payment if deliverables are not completed as per the agreed scope, quality, and timeline.

Action for Nepal reserves the right to reject any submission without providing specific reasons.

11. Submission of Proposal

Interested audit firms are requested to submit their Technical and Financial Proposals (with all required documents) either via email or sealed hard copy by 19th October 2025 (Sunday), 17:00 Hrs to the address below:

The Executive Director

Action for Nepal

Boudha, Kathmandu

Email: actionfnepal@gmail.com

As a global leader, CARE is shaping the future of the humanitarian and development sector. Each year, we deliver support and services to millions of people in over a hundred countries. CARE is a mission-driven international humanitarian aid and development organization that offers an opportunity to work with people across the world. About LISP

The Local Infrastructure Support Programme (LISP) in Nepal is funded by the UK Government and led by the Government of Nepal, with technical assistance provided by DT Global, in partnership with CARE Nepal. The programme strengthens the capacity of local and provincial governments—particularly in Karnali and Lumbini provinces—to plan, finance, and deliver inclusive, climate-resilient infrastructure that meets the needs of their communities, especially women, marginalised groups, and persons with disabilities.

LISP addresses Nepal’s critical infrastructure gaps by enhancing local infrastructure planning integrating climate resilience, promoting Gender Equality, Disability, and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), and improving the cost-effectiveness of infrastructure services. Through targeted technical assistance and capacity building, the programme supports the design and implementation of inclusive infrastructure projects, strengthens financial risk management, promotes good governance, and enables data-driven planning and maintenance across key sectors such as roads, irrigation, water supply, and sanitation.
