name: UWS Nepal
description:
﻿﻿Role Summary

The HR Officer is a key contributor to the success of United World Schools (UWS), responsible for managing and supporting human resource functions. This role focuses on recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, organisational policy implementation, and performance management to ensure a motivated and productive workforce. By aligning HR practices with UWS’s mission to transform education in underserved communities, the HR Officer fosters a supportive, inclusive, and compliant workplace culture.

Duties and Responsibilities

Recruitment and Onboarding

●       Coordinate the full recruitment cycle, including drafting job descriptions, posting vacancies, shortlisting candidates, and scheduling written and interviews.

●       Collaborate closely with hiring managers to recruit qualified and competent candidates in line with the Terms of Reference (ToR).

●       Support hiring processes by participating in interviews and preparing a Memo for approval.

●       Oversee the onboarding of new employees to ensure smooth integration into the organisation.

●       Ensure onboarding staff get a detailed orientation on organisational culture and program implementation modality.

●       Maintain and update organisational job profiles and hiring protocols.

Employee Engagement and Development

●       Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives to promote a positive work environment.

●       Identify training needs and coordinate professional development opportunities.

●       Support performance management, including appraisals and feedback processes in consultation with the line manager, ensuring continuous improvement.

●       Maintain accurate and up-to-date HR databases, ensuring confidentiality of employee records.

●       Lead and organise organisational events such as training, orientation, and team-building activities.

Policy Implementation and Compliance

●       Implement and enforce HR policies and procedures consistently across the organization.

●       Ensure compliance with labour laws and organisational standards.

●       Regularly review and update employee records, including contracts, leave records, and benefits documentation.

●       Assist in developing and updating HR systems and initiatives aligned with organisational goals.

Payroll and Benefits Management

●       Collaborate with the Finance team to ensure accurate payroll processing and timely salary disbursement.

●       Manage employee benefits programs and address related queries.

●       Monitor leave balances, attendance, and adherence to leave policies.

Employee Relations

●       Serve as the primary point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution.

●       Promote a culture of respect, inclusion, and teamwork within the organisation.

●       Provide guidance and counselling on HR policies and procedures.

Qualifications:

Professional qualifications:

●       Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

●       A minimum of 2 years of HR experience, preferably within the nonprofit sector, especially in the education sector.

Desired Skills & Competencies:

●       Solid understanding of HR practices, labour laws, and compliance standards.

●       Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills.

●       Proficiency in MS Office and HR management software/tools.

●       High level of confidentiality and professionalism in handling sensitive information.

●       Excellent organisational, multitasking, and time management abilities.

●       Demonstrated capacity to work collaboratively within a team and with diverse stakeholders.

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please send a comprehensive CV (max two pages) and a supporting statement (no more than two pages) to info.nepal@uwsglobal.net. The deadline for applications is 5 pm on 17 October 2025.

 

You should give the names, positions, organisations, and telephone contact numbers of two referees, one of whom should be your current/most recent employer.  References will only be taken once your express permission has been granted.

name: Social Organization District Coordination Committee, Parsa
description:
﻿﻿Job Description 

1. Admin and Finance Coordinator

Location (base): SODCC Parsa, (Head office, Birgunj Parsa)

Reports to: Finance Manager/Program Manager

Expected joining date: as soon as possible

Probation Period: 3 months

Program Duration: 8 Months

No. of Opening: 1 (One)

Introduction:

Social Organization District Coordination Committee Parsa (SODCC Parsa) is a reputed and non-profitable organization which is established in 1994 and registered district administration office Parsa under the government rules and is also affiliated in social welfare council. Now it has been working for the children and women in Madhesh Province to improve the status of children and women specially focus on the area of education, health, sanitation, child protection, gender-based violence reduction, poverty alleviation, women empowerment, awareness raising and emergency response. Also, it has been working for the capacity enhancement of youth, organizational management, community mobilization, and leadership development of women, children and stakeholders for well planning and program implementation. 

Supporting Adolescent Girls Education (SAGE) programme (formally called SAGE, a non-formal education programme for out-of-school adolescent girls from 8-14 years of age). Girls Education (SAGE) is a 6-month community-based non-formal education program. Further, SAGE graduates are required to re-enrolled in formal education and retention is key challenges for which project will work with selected local governments, and mother schools for rest of project duration to ensure regular attendance and learning continuity to formal education.  SAGE will impart basic functional literacy, numeracy, and life skills to out-of-school adolescent girls, with the aim of preparing them to re-enrolled into the formal school. Considering the existing complexity of the OOS adolescents' issue and the process of re-enrolling them into formal education, ensuring their retention and completion of the education is still a big challenge. Radical and rigorous multi-stakeholder approaches are necessary to bring girls of age group 8-14 back to formal education, ensuring their retention in school and continuation of education. This would be possible through provision of additional and tailored non-formal education to strengthen basic literacy, numeracy, life skills, and confidence of out-of-school adolescent girls along with community engagement for retention that is only possible through the integration of various sectorial interventions.

Scope of work 

The Finance Coordinator will be overall responsible for the project ensuring the financial management of activities of “Supporting Adolescent Girls’ Education (SAGE)/Alternative Learning Package (ALP) ” described on the project work plan, ensuring project output identified in Result Framework, managing budget expenditure, and monitor program implementation with close coordination of government line agencies, funding organization and report project activities to organization.

Major roles and responsibilities:

Finance Management:
  • To ensure all sorts of financial transactions, bookkeeping, budgeting, and budgetary control, auditing, banking, following the organizational financial system/ policy with accuracy and efficiency.
  • To prepare all financial statements required by UNICEF as well as by the auditors and respective Govt. authorities
  • Prepare financial expenses documents and send to UNICEF within time frame.
  • Properly handling account management of the project and organization.
  • Ensure the financial management system is in accordance with organization policy, Donor’s guidelines, International & National Accounting Standard.
  • Maintain petty cash; prepare cash vouchers according to established petty cash level.
  • To monitor field level financial activities of Girls Education Project.
  • Responsible for the overall financial related matters of the organization.
  • Overall budget sheet formatting, planning and compiling.
  • Develop and review financial rules and regulations for approval.
  • Checking financial reports and instruct to the concerned as required.
  • Linkage and coordination between SODCC and funding partners in all financial matters.
  • Responsible for dealing and providing all required information to internal, external and all donor-related audits and SWC on time upon demand.
  • Prepare final accounts of the year-end and present to the management and board.
  • Review the financial system and make a recommendation to the executive director and board.
  • Attend meetings and discuss financial matters as invited by the Board and the Audit Committee.
  • Coordinate and manage to inform all staff on any changes in financial rules and regulations, and provide training to financial staff wherever required.
  • Advise the Director and Manager on the financial management aspect.
  • Responsible for management response to Internal, External and Donor Audits’ queries and ensure the implementation of recommendations through the development of an action plan.
  • Prepare quarterly financial management report and present to the SMT and Treasurer.
  • Prepare annual financial reports for the Treasurer to present in the General Assembly.
  • Ensure the proper financial system is in place at all District offices and headquarters.
  • Ensure the safety of all financial documents as per the financial policy.
  • Identify gaps and capacity needs of finance staff and provide required training & support.
  • Any other finance-related specific tasks of the organization as assigned by the line manager. 
Banking:
  • To coordinate with the bank and manage all banking transactions.
  • To collect all bank statements, cross check with cash book/bank book including maintaining and safeguarding check books and keep proper records in register.
Accounting Management:
  • Reviewing bill/ invoice and claims received from staff and check supporting documents, generate payment voucher, cheque writing and handover to concern party timely manner.
  • To prepare appropriate vouchers (Debit, credit, journal) and post them under appropriate accounts head / code in UNICEF's format after verifying that all organizational procedures are maintained (rate, quotations, requisitions, approval etc.)
  • Ensure and timely payments of vendor’s bills and settlement of advance, balance sheet items and reconcile periodically.
  • Review budget variance monthly/quarterly/annually with reason for variance and prepare justifications report for the management team and donors.
  • Preparing of monthly, quarterly and yearly financial report (using Hard copy and soft copy), variance report, Trail Balance, Statement of Expenditure, Fund Accountability statement (FAS), BRS etc. to submit monthly and quarterly to donor and organization executive board timely
  • Maintain safe and proper filling of voucher, monthly financial report, bank reconciliation statement, and data backup for auditing and further requirement
  • Responsible for overall staff pay roll system, tax calculation and tax report.
Administration & Logistics Management:
  • Coordinates and facilitates the procurement requirements of the program on the basis of the procurement plan and organization policy guidelines.
  • Prepare and maintain qualified vendor restore as per the logistics guideline oncein a year and when any new qualified suppliers are identified.
  • Provide technical support to procurement committee for procurement process and TOR.
  • Maintain and update fixed asset register and get signed the verified list by end of financial year and as per donor requirement.
  • Logistic management for meetings, seminar and workshop.
  • Manage staff & equipment’s insurance(assets and inventory)
  • Assist in developing and implementing of finance/human resource/admin policies and guidelines.
  • Keep leave records of programme staffs.
  • Any other duties indicated by Chairperson/ Executive Director.
Budget/ budgetary control and Audit:
  • To ensure the value of money by close monitoring of the budget vs. expenditure of Girls education project at least on a monthly basis.
  • To ensure follow-up on the measures/action taken against the audit findings/recommendations.
  • Assist and support to internal audit exercise, make a plan to recover and settle the audit issue (if any), prepare internal audit report as required by the organization board or management team
  • Work together with the Executive Director and respective board members in budget management and its implementation.

General Responsibilities

  • Other Task assign by SODCC Parsa/UNICEF.
  • Adhere to SODCC Parsa policies and internal procedures, and protocols, with special attention to Safeguarding Standards and Procedure, Child Protection, and Do No Harm policies; immediate reporting of any complaints and issues. 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in management, business studies/ administration, accounts, or relevant field. 
  • At least two years' experience in a similar position.
  • Prior experience of working with I/NGO will be an added advantage.
  • Computer software competencies including knowledge of MS Office suite (MS Outlook, MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint).  
  • Fluency in English and Nepali language both in writing and oral communication

Desired Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies

  • Strong understanding of formal/Informal &SAGE Programme/ALP and mobilization of young champions. 
  • Applicant should be sharp, flexible, active, positive attitude, and hardworking
  • Fluency of local language of Madhesh Pradesh (Bajika, Maithali, Bhojpuri).
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Having a motorbike with two wheelers driving licence will be given preference.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with two references their updated CV and an Application letter to the email address sodcc.vacancy@gmail.com clearly mentioning the position applying in the subject line addressing to the Human Resource Department, Social Organization District Coordination Committee Parsa (SODCC Parsa), within October 17 by 5:00 PM. 

Candidates from Madhesh Pradesh, women and other marginalized and minority groups are encouraged to apply.

SODCC Parsa is an equal opportunity employer

Only short-listed candidates will be called for further screening process.

Telephone enquiries will not be entertained.

﻿Call for Proposals: External Evaluation of the “Gender-Friendly Himalayan School Project”

EcoHimal Nepal invites proposals from qualified consulting firms or teams of individual consultants to conduct an External Evaluation of the project titled “Gender-Friendly Himalayan School Project”. The project, implemented over a period of three years starting in January 2023, is financially supported by Help Alliance through EcoHimal Austria. It aims to improve:

  • Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health (ASRH) education
  • Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) in Schools (WinS)
  • Self-generated scholarship for needy students
  • Nutrition education among school-going children and their mothers
  • Climate-resilient cultivation practices from school to home by students to support nutrition and green consumption -mini agroforestry in school

The project is being implemented in six rural/municipalities across Kalikot, Achham, Solukhumbu, and Khotang Districts.

name: CRS Nepal
description:
﻿﻿﻿Exciting Opportunities at CRS Nepal

Technical Coordinator, Homes and Communities - Vacancy Announcement

Catholic Relief Services (CRS) is an international humanitarian agency based in the United States working to save, protect, and transform lives in need in more than 100 countries regardless of race, religion or nationality. CRS Nepal started its operational presence in Nepal in response to the 2015 earthquake with emergency support, eventually reaching over 23,000 households in multiple districts with shelter, livelihoods and community infrastructure ensuring accountability to beneficiaries. CRS programs in Nepal currently supports four strategic areas, including Homes and communities, disaster risk reduction and climate change, agriculture and livelihood, and anticipatory actions and emergency response. CRS strives to improve livelihood and resilience of marginalized and vulnerable communities by catalyzing innovation, excellence and system strengthening efforts toward improved integral human development. CRS aims to catalyze transformative changes in lives of marginalized and vulnerable households in country through improved access to safe and dignified housing, improved community resilience to disaster, shocks and stresses, and diversified livelihood opportunities, especially to women and youths. CRS Nepal has been instrumental in implementing multifaceted emergency relief and recovery programs playing a pivotal role in coordinating recovery and reconstruction efforts in responding to the impacts of earthquakes, monsoons, and the COVID-19 pandemic.

Homes and Community (H&C) Programme in CRS Nepal

CRS Nepal’s Strategic Plan (2025-30) prioritizes H&C as one priority programming areas. Building on CRS Nepal’s expertise in shelter interventions, the H&C Program plans to work to increase access of vulnerable and at-risk people to safe and dignified shelters/homes and settlements. To promote and scale up accessible and affordable shelter solutions and resilient housing, CRS Nepal plans to standardize technical solutions, strengthen and localize government system, and promote collaboration within the humanitarian system.

Job Summary: The Technical Coordinator will serve as technical lead for the piloting of Climate and Earthquake Resilient Homes using Lime Stabilized Soil (LSS) in high mountains and supports the capacity building of local and provincial governments in Bagmati province for strengthening building regulatory system. Your expertise and knowledge in LSS technology and improving building regulatory system will deliver high-quality pilot and capacity development works towards generating the proof-of-concept positioning CRS for greater scaling opportunities.

Further, you understand that if you are a successful candidate, you will be subject to a comprehensive background check, and your personal/professional references will be asked to evaluate your behaviors related to the above safeguarding-related topics.

CRS is an equal opportunity employer committed to a staff composition that reflects the social and ethnic diversity of Nepali Society. It encourages applicants from marginalized communities and geographically remote areas, persons with disabilities, women and other genders are encouraged to apply. वल्र्ड भिजन इन्टरनेसलन (World Vision International Nepal) सँगको सहकार्यमा महोत्तरी जिल्लाको सम्सी र एकडाँरा गाउँपालिकामा बाल स्पोन्सारसीप कार्यक्रम (Sponsorship Operation Plan), लैङगिक समानता, अपाङ्गता तथा समावेशीकरण(GEDSI) तथा बालसंरक्षण (Child Protection) मार्फत बाल समृद्धिको सुनिश्चिताको लागि कार्यक्रमहरू सञ्चालन भईरहेको हु‘दा उक्त कार्यक्रममा तपशील अनुसारका कार्मचारीहरु आवश्यक रहेकाले योग्यता पुगेका नेपाली नागरिकहरूबाट दरखास्तको लागि अहवान गरिन्छ ।

पद तथा संख्याशैक्षिक योग्यताआवश्यक योग्यता तथा सीपहरू

सामुदायिक परिचालक

(Community Mobilizer)

२ जना

१०+२ उतिर्ण (शिक्षा विषय पढेकालाई गाह्रयता दिनेछ ।)
  • समाजिक परिचालन तथा बालबालिकाको क्षेत्रमा कम्तीमा पनि २ वर्षको अनुभव प्राप्त गरेको ।
  • सरोकारवालाहरूसँग समन्वय र सहकार्य गर्न सक्ने क्षमता भएको ।
  • परिणात्मक तथा गुणात्मक तथ्याङ्क संड्ढलन गर्न सक्ने ।
  • स्थानीय स्तरमा रहेको सरकारी तथा गैह्रसरकारी संघसंस्थाहरूसँग आत्मविश्वासी तथा मैत्रीपुर्ण वातावरणमा काम गर्न सक्ने ।
  • अन्तर वैयक्तिक कला र सहजीकरण सीप भएको ।
  • बाल सुरक्षण, बाल अधिकार , बालमैत्री स्थानीय शासन तथा स्पोन्सारसीप कार्यक्रम सम्बन्धी कार्य अनुभव भएको ।
  • नेपाली भाषमा प्रतिवेदन लेख्ने सक्ने ।
  • Office package; Word, Excel, Power point and email internet मा राम्रो ज्ञान भएको साथै स्मार्ट फोन चलाउन सक्ने

स्पोन्सारसीप परिचालक(Sponsorship Mobilizer)

९ जना

जना १०+२ उतिर्ण (शिक्षा विषय पढेकालाई गाह्रयता दिनेछ ।)
  • समाजिक परिचालन तथा बालबालिकाको क्षेत्रमा कम्तीमा पनि २ वर्षको अनुभव प्राप्त गरेको ।
  • सरोकारवालाहरूसँग समन्वय र सहकार्य गर्न सक्ने क्षमता भएको ।
  • बाल संरक्षण, बाल अधिकार तथा स्पोन्सारसीप कार्यक्रम सम्बन्धि कार्य अनुभव भएको । परिणात्मक तथा गुणात्मक तथ्याङ्क संड्ढलन गर्न सक्ने ।
  • स्थानिय स्तरमा रहेको सरकारी तथा गैरसरकारी संघसंस्थाहरूसँग आत्म विश्वासी तथा मैत्रीपुर्ण वातावरणमा काम गर्न सक्ने ।
  • अन्तर वैयक्तिक कला र सहजीकरण सीप भएको ।
  • अंग्रेजी र नेपाली भाषमा प्रतिवेदन लेख्ने सक्ने ।
  • Office package; World, Excel, Power point and email internet मा राम्रो ज्ञान भएको साथै स्मार्ट फोन चलाउन सक्ने ।
आवेदन साथ पेश गर्नु पर्ने कागजातहरू
  • व्यक्तिगत विवरण (Personal bio-data),
  • निवेदन (Application),
  • नेपाली नागरिकता प्रमाणपत्रको प्रतिलिपि (Copy of citizenship),
  • शैक्षिक योग्यताको प्रमाणपत्रहरूको प्रतिलिपि (Copy of educational certificates),
  • तालिम तथा कार्यअनुभव पत्रहरूको प्रतिलिपि (Copy of training certificate and experience letter)
  • दुई जना सन्दर्भ व्यक्तिहरूको विस्तृत विवरण (Two reference Persons details)
आवेदन दिने अन्तिम मितिसूचना प्रकाशित भएको मितिले ७ दिन भित्र कार्यालय समयमा र अन्तिम दिन बिदा परे सोको भोलि पल्ट ।
आवेदन पेश गर्ने स्थान रतरिकास्थानः— दलित समाज उत्थान समिति नेपालको कार्यालय, जनकपुरधाम ४, (विश्वक्रमा चोक) वा जलेश्वर न.पा.१, नगरपालिका चौक, बखरी रोड

ईमेलः dswcn.vacancy2023@gmail.com मा आवेदन इमेल गर्न सकिन्छ ।

फोन नं.: ९८५४०२९२७७

संक्षिप्त सूचीमा परेका आवेदकहरूलाई मात्र लिखित, मौखिक तथा कम्प्युटर प्रस्तुतीकरण प्रक्रियामा समावेश गरिनेछ ।

कुनै पनि आवेदन वा सम्पुर्ण आवेदनहरू स्वीकार/अस्वीकार गर्ने अधिकार संस्थामा सुरक्षित रहनेछ ।

संस्था तथा कार्यक्रमले कर्मचारीमा विविधताको प्रर्वद्धन गर्दछ र कर्मचारीको छनौटमा महिला तथा दलित, जनजाति, मधेशी तथा अन्य अल्पसंख्यक समुदायका उम्मेदवारहरूको समावेशीकरणको लागि साकारात्मक विभेदको आधारमा विशेष गाह्रयता प्रदान गर्दछ ।

बालमैत्री तथा पोषणमैत्री स्थानीय शासन लागू गरौँ । बालबालिकाको लागि सुरक्षित समाज निर्माण गरौँ ।

name: People, Energy and Environment Development Association
description:
﻿﻿JOB DESCRIPTION

1. Job Title: Project Coordinator – Electric Cooking Projects

Location: Kathmandu with occasional field visit

Employment Type: Full-Time

Duration: 2 years (with possibility of extension)

Overview of the Role

The Project Coordinator will lead the implementation of electric cooking projects, ensuring timely delivery, stakeholder engagement, and effective monitoring. This role requires a dynamic individual with technical knowledge, field experience in renewal energy sector, and strong communication skills.

Details of Roles and Responsibilities

A) Project Planning and Implementation 

  • Develop comprehensive timelines and detailed implementation plan (Weekly, Monthly, Annual), Gantt Chart of the project
  • Coordinate, oversee and manage day-to-day operations of the electric cooking projects
  • Liaison with local government to ensure conducive environment for the implementation of project activities
  • Coordinate with internal and external resources, suppliers and third partiers
  • Proactively identify project risks and challenges beforehand and develop mitigation measures
  • Plan activities within the approved budget, timeline ensuring cost efficiency and effectiveness
  • Conduct regular filed visits to track progress, troubleshoot issues and ensure compliance with donor and organization standards
  • Prepare selection criteria of beneficiaries/institutions for support of electric cooking technologies
  • Prepare survey questionnaires for baseline/mid-term/endline for project initiation, implementation, progress and achievement.

B) Resource and Budget Management

  • Track and manage the project budget and resources efficiently and effectively. 
  • Ensure field activities are carried out smoothly within the approved program and budget.
  • Maintain proper records of daily expenses with bills/receipts.
  • Follow procurement guidelines for local purchases (bid document preparation, bid collection, documentation, approval etc).
  • Prepare and submit financial reports timely to the required party
  • Keep track record of project assets (cooking equipment, training materials, etc.).
  • Assist in preparing annual/quarterly budgets and monitor proper budget utilization.
  • Coordinate for the timely fund disbursement to field level and reconcile advances.
  • Analyze budget vs. actual expenditure and report deviations with justifications.
  • Prepare consolidated financial reports for donors 
  • Support donor financial monitoring and internal/external audits.

C) Community Mobilization

  • Conduct school assessment based on set criteria to finalize the participating schools
  • Mobilize communities and raise awareness on the promotion of electric cooking
  • Facilitate awareness events and sensitization programs on electric cooking technologies at the selected schools. 
  • Ensure meaningful participation of schools and beneficiaries over the period of project duration.

D) Performance Monitoring and Control

  • Monitor project progress against planned schedules, log frame and budget 
  • Track key performance indicators to meet the quality and standards of the project 
  • Adapt and adjust project plans, schedule or budget as necessary to meet project requirements.
  • Provide technical backstopping to users to increase usage rate of electric cooking technologies 
  • Prepare and maintain database of each activity
  • Conduct financial assessment/ cost savings of electric cooking technologies along with greenhouse gas emissions calculations and fuel savings.
  • Collect and document success stories, challenges, lessons learned from the project interventions and capture photos and videos where relevant and support in replication of best practices
  • Ensure timely accomplishment of result-based indicators as guided by project proposal log-frame.
  • Mobilize and Supervise project staffs
  • Prepare periodic reports and other documents as required to be submitted to the donor and government offices.

E) Knowledge Management, Logistical Support and Capacity Building

  • Facilitate distribution, support and use of electric cooking technologies to schools. 
  • Coordinate with local resource person/service providers for external support in project intervention as per the requirement. 
  • Organize and facilitate workshops, training sessions and awareness campaigns on electric cooking technologies
  • Take lead in developing knowledge management materials of electric cooking projects

F) Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination

  • Conduct stakeholder meetings, build and maintain good relationships with Provincial and Local Governments, school management Committees, community leaders and relevant stakeholders
  • Ensure stakeholder satisfaction with project results and outcomes
  • Represent the organization and the project at all levels and advocate for alignment of the project into local level’s priorities
  • Maintain synergy and coordination with other development partners for the collaborative efforts for the smooth and result oriented implementation

G) Project Closing and Documentation

  • Ensure all project activities are completed to achieve the planned results
  • Secure appropriate project closing document with signature from school management upon project completion
  • Conduct post implementation reviews/ endline surveys to document lessons learned for future projects. 
  • Prepare project completion reports and submit to SWC, Donor and others as required

Qualification and Skills

Requirement
Details
Education 
Master’s degree in engineering, Environmental Science, or related field
Experience
Minimum 5 years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in renewable energy or clean cooking projects
Technical Knowledge
Understanding of electric cooking technologies, behaviour change strategies, energy access, installation and related matters
Communication
Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to engage with diverse stakeholders
Software Proficiency

Skilled in Microsoft Office package, especially

Microsoft Word, Excel and Powerpoint; data collection and analysis tools 

Personal Attributes
Motivated, team-oriented, analytical thinker, and adaptable to field conditions, Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines

2. Job Title: Project Officer – Electric Cooking Projects

Location: Kathmandu with field visit trips at project locations 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Duration: 2 years (with possibility of extension)

Overview of the Role

The Project Officer will support the planning, implementation, and monitoring of electric cooking initiatives. This role involves field coordination with frequent field travel, stakeholder engagement, data collection, and reporting to ensure successful delivery of project objectives.

A) Project Planning, Implementation and Support

  • Assist in developing detailed implementation project plans, schedules and budgets
  • Assist in the roll out of electric cooking technologies in target communities/institutions/schools.
  • Work with communities and local institutions to support behavior change and adoption of electric cooking appliances such as induction stoves and electric pressure cookers.
  • Coordinate with vendors, technicians, and technical team members for technology installations and after-sales service.

B) Stakeholder Engagement, Coordination and Communication

  • Coordinate project activities and tasks across different team members
  • Facilitate effective communication among team members with external stakeholders including government bodies, community leaders and others.
  • Represent the organization in local stakeholder meetings, workshops, and events.

C) Monitoring, Data Collection, Documentation and Reporting

  • Monitor project progress, identify risks and help mitigate issues and challenges
  • Conduct appropriate surveys as required and collect field data for monitoring and evaluation using data collection tools
  • Travel frequently to project sites to oversee field activities support field team and engage with the beneficiaries
  • Collect and record data on appliance usage, energy consumption, user experience, and social impact
  • Maintain project documentation, records and contracts, and prepare regular progress/ activity reports
  • Prepare progress reports, write case studies, and documentation for internal and donor use

D) Capacity Building, Resource, Event and Meeting Management

  • Assist in managing resources for the project implementation
  • Schedule and organize meetings, take minutes and share meeting minutes
  • Organize and facilitate training sessions, demonstrations, and awareness campaigns on electric cooking technologies
  • Develop educational materials, knowledge management documents and awareness-raising content in collaboration with other team members.

E) Procurement and Administrative Support

  • Support procurement and effective distribution of electric cooking appliances
  • Assist in logistical arrangement including procurement, inventory management, transport, and event organization.
  • Provide various administrative functions to support higher supervisors and teams. 
  • Assist project and office as required and as advised by the reporting officer

Qualification and Skills

Requirement
Details
Education 
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Environmental Science, Development Studies, Sociology or related field
Experience
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in renewable energy field or community development, with at least 2 years in renewable energy or clean cooking projects
Technical Knowledge
Familiarity of electric cooking technologies, behaviour change strategies, energy access, installation and related matters
Communication
Strong interpersonal and multi-media skills
Software Proficiency

Skilled in Microsoft Office package, especially 

Microsoft Word, Excel and Powerpoint; data collection, analysis tools

Personal Attributes
Field-oriented, proactive, culturally sensitive, and committed to timely delivery of project activities

3. Job Title: Technical Officer – Electric Cooking Projects

Location: Kathmandu with frequent travel to project locations

Employment Type: Full-Time

Duration:12 months (with possibility of extension)

Overview of the Role

The Technical Officer will provide hands-on technical support for the design, implementation, and monitoring of electric cooking projects. This includes evaluating technologies, supporting procurement and installation, training stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with safety and performance standards.

A) Technical Oversight and Project Implementation

  • Oversee the technical aspect of the project including demonstration, installation, troubleshooting and maintenance of the equipment
  • Support the project team in planning, coordinating and executing project activities related to electric cooking solutions
  • Support the selection, procurement, and testing of appropriate e-cooking technologies based on local context.
  • Develop technical guidelines, standards, and quality assurance protocols for project implementation.
  • Conduct energy audits and load assessments to determine household, institutional, or community readiness for electric cooking adoption.
  • Resolve any technical issues or challenges that arise during the installation of electric cooking technologies.

B) Quality Assurance and Stakeholder Liaison

  • Conduct technical assessments/ inspections of electric cooking appliances and infrastructure and
  • ensure all installations comply with relevant standards, safety protocols and regulations
  • Serve as a technical point of contact, liaising with government authorities, utilities, project partners, suppliers, research institutions, development partners, contractors to ensure smooth project progress
  • Represent the organization in technical working groups, community meetings, and policy dialogues on clean cooking.
  • Collaborate with team members and community mobilizers to ensure integrated delivery
  • Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards and environmental regulations

C) Training and Capacity Building

  • Develop and deliver training materials for households, institutions, community groups, technicians, users, and partners on electric cooking use, maintenance and safety
  • Assist in the facilitation of any training and capacity building activities on electric cooking solutions
  • Develop user manuals, training materials, and awareness content in simple and localized language.

D) Knowledge Management, Reporting and Monitoring

  • Prepare and document technical reports, policy briefs, technology usage analysis, best practices and provide recommendations for the project
  • Prepare technical guidelines of installation considering safety protocols based on which installation of electric cooking technologies are done
  • Assist in piloting innovative cooking technologies and evaluating their scalability
  • Conduct field studies, baseline/endline surveys, and case studies on e-cooking adoption, performance, and user satisfaction.
  • Conduct site visits to monitor project progress, assess conditions, gather data for project evaluation and decision making
  • Analyze energy consumption patterns, affordability, and economic viability of electric cooking interventions.
  • Monitor performance and usage of electric cooking technologies in the field
  • Maintain a database of e-cooking technologies, suppliers, and market information.

E) Procurement Support

  • Assist with the technical aspects of the procurement of electric cooking technologies, ensuring project specifications. 

Qualification and Skills

Requirement
Details
Education 
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Renewable Energy or related field
Experience
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in renewable energy field, clean cooking or electrical related installations
Technical Knowledge
Strong understanding of electric cooking appliances, grid/off-grid systems, and energy efficiency; Hands-on skills in appliance testing, troubleshooting, and quality assurance
Communication Skills
Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences; strong reporting skills
Software Proficiency

Skilled in Microsoft Office package, especially 

Microsoft Word, Excel and Powerpoint; data collection tools, engineering design tools

Personal Attributes
Field-oriented, proactive, culturally sensitive, and committed to timely delivery of project activities; Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams
Travel Willingness
Willingness to travel frequently to project sites, often in rural and semi-urban areas

To apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their Curriculum Vitae and Cover Letter to prem@peeda.net. Please include “Application for the Position of <>” in the subject line. The application deadline is 18th October 2025. We encourage applications from all candidates, irrespective of gender, religious and ethnic backgrounds, to apply to become a part of the organization. Qualified women and candidates from marginalized communities are strongly encouraged to apply.

name: Bahadur Social Project
job-type: Bachelor's degree in a related field
description:
﻿Vacancy announcement for Agriculture Officer

Published on : 9TH Oct-2025

Wishing Welfare Nepal is a dedicated nonprofit organization committed to uplifting communities across Nepal. Wishing Welfare Nepal is a group that believes in cooperation and collaboration for positive change. Our goal is ‘making world better’ for people who are struggling socially and economically.

Wishing Welfare Nepal in collaboration with 'Bahadur Social Project' (BSP), which is a Spanish non-profit organization, is looking for a committed Agriculture Officer, based in the field (in Gandaki Rural Municipality, Gorkha), to implement project activities, working in a Chepang community. 

The Agriculture officer should agree to live under minimum conditions, based in the Wishing Welfare Nepal -BSP office in the field.

Job Purpose:

The organization wishes to recruit a full-time Agriculture Officer to join its team and oversee the project “livelihood improvement through Commercial Farming ” at ward 6, Gandaki Rural Municipality in Gorkha District. The position directly leads the implementation of the project results, coordinates project stakeholders, i.e. local authorities as per requirement. The position ensures efficient and timely implementation of the project according to a Detailed Implementation Plan (DIP) and budget, ensuring the success of the project as per project’s log frame.  Under the supervision of Program Director, the position is expected to implement activities/processes without compromising the quality. He/she has to develop the DIP, sustainability plan and appropriate exit strategy, training manual for Tomato, Cabbage& Cauliflower, Cucumber, Bee Keeping  and Mushroom Cultivation  and donor compliance while implementing the project.

Responsibilities:

Main objectives: build relations with major stakeholders and implement the cycle based agriculture training on Tomato, Cabbage& Cauliflower, Cucumber, Bee Keeping and Mushroom Cultivation.

1. Job Responsibilities

Program activity implementation and management
  • Develop training modules and be responsible for all program training activities
  • Planning with process of specific crops and run farmers training
  • Support Manager/ coordinator in project planning, budget management, stakeholder engagement, coordination, creating synergies and leverage in the field.
  • Implement project activities at the field level as per approved work plan and budget, ensuring their effectiveness.
  • Identify issues and risks in project implementation and provide potential measures to address those issues; in close coordination with project team.
  • Mobilize/mentoring the social mobilizer.
Coordination and Liaison:
  • Coordinate, network and develop cooperation with Rural Municipalities/ private sectors, thematic networks and other relevant stakeholders
  • Coordinate monitoring visits of government agencies and donors;
Monitoring, Documentation and Reporting :
  • Make field visits as a part of regular monitoring and provide feedback to the project team.   
  • To collect and maintain field level information and database as required for the project. 
  • Document experiences, lessons learned, best practices, case studies, stories, photos replicable strategies/ approaches and support in knowledge management based on the organization given format 
  • Provide regular and reliable narrative and financial reports with proper billing and legitimate documents where required.
  • Support field coordinator as for need and support to farmers to plant cultivation, processing and promotion. 
General:
  • Carry out other duties and responsibilities assigned by the management.
  • Always try to improve yourself for better performance;

Requirements:

  • Nepalese nationality.
  • Bachelor's degree in agriculture science, or similar (botany, natural resource management, ecology, forestry, horticulture etc.), and at least two years practical field experience of growing tomato, cucumber, cabbage, and mushroom cultivation. OR more than five years of working experience and knowledge of the related field with any educational background.
  • Excellent written and verbal English and Nepali.
  • 15 months’ commitment is required.
  • At least a year of experience working in a rural place in the humanitarian sector. 
  • 85% of the time (average) will be spent in the field, living with the rest of the team under limited conditions. 
  • IT skills: MS Office, to be able to write reports and budget.
  • Salary: following the Wishing Welfare Nepal - BSP scales.

What we can offer as an employer: We are offering an outstanding opportunity to become a leader, bringing a change to the most vulnerable through a development organization with a young team and a growing profile. Transportation cost to and from the field, communication and food will be provided by organization.  

If your profile fits the above criteria, Kindly send your CV to; info@wishingwelfarenepal.org with mentioned salary expectation. The last date for submitting the application is 17:00 hours, October  16, 2025. 

Only short-listed candidates will be called for interview. Visit wishingwelfarenepal.org for regular updates.

name: Helvetas Nepal
description:
﻿﻿﻿Vacancy Announcement

Helvetas Nepal is a Swiss non-governmental organization actively contributing to the improvement of the living conditions of poor and disadvantaged people in Nepal. Helvetas Nepal invites applications from dynamic and committed Nepali citizens for the following positions.

1. Position title: Fundraising and Communication Coordinator

Job purpose: The position will focus on enhancing the organization’s visibility, strengthening donor relations, and diversifying the funding base to support organisational sustainability. It will also play a key role in positioning Helvetas Nepal as a thought leader in its thematic areas through strategic communication and engagement.

Required Education, Experiences and Competencies: 

Master’s degree in International Relations, Communication, Journalism, Development Studies,  or related field. At least 5 years of experience in fundraising, donor relations, and communication within INGOs, NGOs, or development organizations. Commitment towards gender equality, social inclusion, and poverty reduction.

Link: JD for Fundraising and Communication Coordinator

2. Position title: Knowledge Management (KM) and Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL) Coordinator

Job purpose: The position will be instrumental in strengthening Helvetas Nepal’s learning culture by integrating MEL systems with effective knowledge management at the country office level, facilitating to capture, organize, and disseminate organizational knowledge and learning. Additionally, the role encompasses responsibilities for providing executive coordination support to the Country Director.

Required Education, Experiences and Competencies: 

Master’s degree in Development Studies, Information Management, Communication Studies, Public Policy, Sociology, Statistics, or related discipline. At least 5 years of working experience in KM, MEL and project coordination within development or humanitarian organizations. Experience in supporting senior leadership and executive-level coordination is highly desirable. Familiarity with multi-sectoral development programming and donor reporting requirements preferred. Commitment towards gender equality, social inclusion, and poverty reduction.

Link: JD for Knowledge Management (KM) and Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL) Coordinator

3. Position title: Operations Officer

Job purpose: The position is responsible for ensuring smooth day-to-day operational support for the organization. This role covers administrative management, logistics coordination, vehicle and inventory management, and procurement functions, ensuring compliance with organizational policies, donor requirements, and applicable regulations.

Required Education, Experiences and Competencies:

Minimum bachelor’s degree in business management, or related discipline. प्राथमिकता: संस्था तथा कार्यक्रमले सकारात्मक विभेदिकरणको नीति अबलम्बन गर्ने भएकाले लैङ्गिक समानता, विविधता तथा सामाजिक समावेशीकरण, सिमान्तकृत समुदायलाई सकारात्मक विभेद गरिनेछ । साथै विज्ञापन नं. ०२/२०८२/०८३ सामुदायिक स्वयंसेवकका लागि कार्यक्रमको कार्यक्षेत्र रहेका ठूलीभेरी र त्रिपुरासुन्दरी नगरपालिका डोल्पाका स्थानीय तथा स्थायी वासिन्दाले मात्र दरखास्त पेश गर्न पाइनेछ । यदि नेपाली नागरिकतामा सो भन्दा अन्य स्थानको ठेगाना रहेको तर हाल कार्यक्रक्षेत्रका पालिकाहरूमा स्थायी वसोवास गर्ने भएमा सो को प्रमाण समेत पेश गर्नुपर्नेछ । जसमा विवाह दर्ताको प्रमाणपत्र, मतदाता परिचय पत्र वा वसाइसराइको प्रमाणपत्र मध्ये कुनै एक मात्र मान्य हुनेछ ।

दरखास्त दिने विधि: सन्दर्भ व्यक्तिहरुको नाम, सम्पर्क नं., इमेल ठेगाना, आफ्नो इमेल र सम्पर्क नं. सहितको व्यक्तिगत विवरण (वायोडाटा) सहित यसै सूचनामा रहेको https://bit.ly/sacnepal82 मार्फत दरखास्त दिन सकिनेछ । म्याद नाघी आएका, तोकिएका शैक्षिक योग्यता पुरा नभएका, तोकिएका मापदण्ड पुरा नगरेका, रितपूर्वक नपरेका वा म्याद नाघी आएका दरखास्तहरू स्वीकृत गर्न संस्था वाध्य हुनेछैन । यस संस्था यौंन उत्पीडन, शोषण र दूव्र्यवहार एवम् बाल दूव्र्यवहार रोक्नका लागि संस्थाको संरक्षण नीति तथा अन्य सम्बन्धित नीतिहरुसहित प्रतिबद्ध रहेको छ । यदि आवेदन पेश गर्ने व्यक्तिको यस संस्थामा कुनै नजिकको नाता लाग्ने व्यक्ति वा कुनै स्वार्थको द्वन्द्व (Conflict of Interest) छ भने आवेदनको साथमा उल्लेख वा स्व–घोषणा गर्नुहुन समेत जानकारी गराइन्छ । प्रारम्भिक छनौंटमा परेका उमेदवारहरूलाई मात्र लिखित तथा मौखिकसहित छनौंट प्रक्रियामा समावेश गरिनेछ । संस्थाले पूर्ण वा आंशिक रुपमा कुनै पनि आवेदन विना शर्त स्वीकृत गर्ने वा नगर्ने अधिकार आफूमा निहित गर्दछ ।

आवेदन पेश गर्ने अन्तिम मिति: मिति २०८२।०६।२९ गते दिनको ५:०० बजेसम्म । यदि कुनै कुरा बुझ्नुपरेमा तल उल्लेखित इमेल वा फोन नं. सम्पर्क गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ ।

name: UWS Nepal
description:
ROLE SUMMARY: 

The MEAL Manager is responsible for overseeing the strategic direction and operational execution of the Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) functions across UWS Nepal’s portfolio. This position will play a leadership role in the design, implementation, and refinement of MEAL frameworks, ensuring that all projects adhere to UWS standards and achieve their intended outcomes. The MEAL Manager will manage the MEAL team, guide data-driven decision-making, and foster organizational learning and programmatic improvement. As a senior leader, the MEAL Manager will liaise with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring that UWS Nepal’s impact is effectively measured, reported, and communicated. 

Duties and Responsibilities

1. Strategic Leadership and Framework Development:

- Lead the development, implementation, and continuous refinement of MEAL frameworks, systems, and procedures across all UWS Nepal programs.

- Align MEAL processes with organizational strategy and ensure the integration of learning into program design and management.

- Provide leadership in setting MEAL priorities, establishing performance indicators, and ensuring the development of robust data collection, analysis, and reporting systems.

- Ensure the standardization and consistency of MEAL practices across all districts

- Engage in strategic discussions with senior management and guide decision-making with MEAL findings.

2. Oversight of Data Collection, Monitoring, and Evaluation:

- Lead the design of tools, methodologies, and protocols for data collection, entry, and analysis, including the use of KOBO tool for data management.

- Oversee the implementation of baseline studies, mid-term reviews, endline evaluations, and other critical assessments.

- Ensure the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of data collection by MEAL Officers and MEAL Associates..

- Supervise the integration of Education Management Information Systems (EMIS) into monitoring processes and ensure consistent application.

- Identify and mitigate risks related to data integrity and propose corrective actions where necessary.

3. Accountability and Learning:

- Foster a culture of accountability and learning within the organization by ensuring that MEAL findings are utilized to inform programmatic improvements.

- Lead the analysis and synthesis of evaluation results and ensure these are shared and discussed with relevant teams.

- Promote and document best practices and lessons learned, ensuring these inform future program designs.

- Work with external evaluators, consultants, and research institutions to ensure independent and rigorous assessments of UWS Nepal programs.

4. Team Management and Capacity Building:

- Supervise and mentor MEAL Officers and Associates, fostering their professional growth and performance.

- Lead capacity-building efforts within the MEAL team, ensuring continuous skills development in data analysis, reporting, and evaluation methods.

- Promote teamwork, communication, and coordination among MEAL staff and across other departments.

- Ensure proper onboarding and training for new MEAL team members.

5. Communication and Reporting:

- Produce high-quality impact reports, visualizations, and presentations based on MEAL data for internal and external stakeholders, utilizing Power BI for data visualization.

- Ensure that all reporting requirements, both internal (monthly, quarterly, annual) and external (donor-specific), are met on time and with precision.

- Present MEAL findings and progress reports to senior management, donors, government stakeholders, and community representatives.

- Ensure that feedback from beneficiaries is collected, analysed, and integrated into programmatic decisions.

6. Stakeholder Engagement:

- Represent UWS Nepal in external meetings, workshops, and forums related to MEAL and learning.

- Liaise with government agencies, donors, and partners to ensure alignment with national and international MEAL standards.

- Coordinate closely with the Country Director, Head of Programmes, Program Managers, and external partners for joint monitoring and evaluation efforts.

- Lead on evaluations commissioned by donors or partners and ensure that these align with UWS priorities.

7. Innovation and Continuous Improvement:

- Lead the introduction of innovative tools, technologies, and methodologies for MEAL to enhance program delivery and impact measurement.

- Explore opportunities for integrating digital platforms, mobile data collection, and real-time monitoring tools (such as KOBO) to improve efficiency.

- Identify and assess emerging trends in MEAL that can be applied to UWS Nepal’s context.

Person Specification

- Master’s degree in international development, Social Sciences, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

- At least 5 years of experience in a senior MEAL position within an NGO, development, or humanitarian context.

- Proven expertise in designing MEAL frameworks, impact evaluations, and data analysis.

- Strong proficiency in data management and visualization tools, including KOBO tool and Power BI.

- Strong proficiency in MS Office and Google Suites.

- Experience managing teams and building capacity.

- Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and Nepali.

- Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.

Reporting and Supervision

The MEAL Manager will report directly to the Sr. Education Manager (Nepal). He/she will work collaboratively with in-country programme teams, the field team, and other colleagues at UWS Nepal.

How to apply

To apply for this position, please send a cover letter and CV of no more than two pages in English by 15 October 2025. You should give the names, positions, organisations, and contact details of two references, one of whom should be your current (or most recent) employer.

Please also include your expected salary for this position.

Applications should be made via email to info.nepal@uwsglobal.net by 15 October 2025.

UWS Nepal is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to our inclusive principles and do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, age, status or sexuality. We welcome applications from any candidate with relevant experience.

name: British Council
description:
﻿Request for Applications: Consultant

The British Council is the UK’s international organisation for cultural relations and educational opportunities. We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. Through our arts, education and English programmes, we give opportunities to millions of people worldwide each year. We are on the ground in six continents and over 100 countries. The British Council has been operating in Nepal since 1959.

The Going Global Partnerships programme TVET (GGP TVET) was launched to support TVET partnerships that support quality improvement and internationalisation of TVET. GGP TVET has been contributing to the outcome of “Improved quality and efficiency of TVET systems and institutions, aligned to labour market needs”, working with TVET stakeholders in various countries, including the government and the private sector.

As part of the GGP programme, British Council is recruiting a National TVET Expert to support GSAB for developing a gender-sensitive roadmap for green TVET in Nepal. name: Dalit JanKalyan Yuba Club Lahan
description:
﻿﻿﻿﻿VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Dalit Jan Kalyan Yuba Club (DJKYC) is a local non-profit and non-political organization based in Bastipur (Pradip Giri Ashram), Ward 14, working towards eliminating discrimination and improving the well-being of women and children. DJKYC also focuses on improving Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) facilities in Lahan UM. DJKYC has been working in different Nepali communities since its establishment in 2000 AD.

The Beacon Project is a joint initiative supported by Anglian Water and WaterAid Nepal (WAN), implemented in collaboration with DJKYC (Dalit Jan Kalyan Yuba Club) Lahan. Key partners include Nepal Water Supply Corporation (NWSC) and Lahan Municipality. The project focuses on delivering impactful WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene) interventions, promoting health and hygiene awareness, improving water supply systems, and fostering community engagement, particularly among Dalit , poor & marginalized groups, to achieve Sustainable Development Goal 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation). 

DJKYC in partnership with WaterAid Nepal invites application from interested and eligible candidates. All candidates are request to mention the expected salary in application

VACANCY#-1

Sanitation Campaign Coordinator–1 ( DJKYC-Lahan Municipality)

Position Title: Sanitation Campaign Coordinator

Location: DJKYC, Lahan Municipality, Nepal

Reports To: Executive Director (direct), with functional reporting to Project Manager(DJKYC) and Sanitation Expert (WaterAid Nepal). 

Duty Station: Lahan Municipality (with frequent field travel to wards/settlements)

Contract Type: Project-based, with possibility of extension based on performance and funding

About the role:

The Sanitation Campaign Coordinator will play a key role in driving community engagement and behavior change to support activities under the sanitation campaign. The position focuses on mobilizing households, schools, community groups, and local leaders toreinstate and sustain the Open Defecation Free (ODF) status in the communities, adopt sustainable sanitation and hygiene practices, and build community ownership for long-term change.

Job Description:

1. Coordination & Communication:

  • Coordinate with Municipality specially in WASH Unit and partners for project sharing and insure to smoothly running the program in time.
  • Coordinate with ward chairpersons, health workers, teachers, women’s groups, FCHVs, HMGs, and CBOs to integrate sanitation messages into community structures.
  • Form and facilitate ward/community-level meetings and strengthen linkages with local government, MWACC/WWACC, and civil society networks.
  • Work in close collaboration with WaterAid Nepal Beacon Team, DJKYC staff, and partners for harmonized implementation.
  • Uphold DJKYC’s safeguarding, gender equality, and Do No Harm commitments in all engagements.

2.Technical Support:

  • Provide guidance on toilet construction, repair, and low-cost models.
  • Train community members, youth volunteers, and local masons in sanitation technologies.
  • Monitor functionality, quality, and sustainability of constructed toilets.
  • Ensure technical support aligns with municipality/WASH guidelines and standards.
  • Assist households in selecting appropriate toilet models based on local context and affordability.

3. Community Mobilization & Engagement:

  • Facilitate community engagement and awareness campaigns to support sanitation campaign implementation.
  • Identify and follow up with slippage households (those reverting to OD) to ensure toilet reconstruction/repair and sustained toilet-use practices.
  • Mobilize local resources and strengthen community ownership to sustain ODF (Open Defecation Free) status.
  • Promote health and hygiene behavior change through household visits, demonstrations, and dialogues to encourage consistent toilet use and improved hygiene practices.
  • Ensure inclusion and equity by engaging women, youth, and marginalized groups in sanitation activities.
  • Support households in constructing self-resourced toilets.
  • Provide technical support during sanitation-related emergencies (e.g., diarrheal outbreaks, floods).

4. Monitoring & Supervision:

  • Supervise and mentor , sanitation activists and youth volunteers/ambassadors , ensuring quality facilitation and achievement of targets.
  • Track and analyze progress of household sanitation practices, including slippage cases and adoption of toilet use.
  • Compile ward-level data and submit timely updates to the WASH Unit and partners.
  • Use m-Water and NWSAH applications for data collection, monitoring, and reporting.

5. Budgeting & Planning:

  • Support municipality in sanitation campaign planning and budgeting.
  • Facilitate allocation and mobilization of local government and external resources for sanitation sustainability.
  • Contribute to participatory planning with community stakeholders to align with municipal WASH priorities.

6. Capacity Building & Training: 

  • Organize training, workshops, and participatory learning sessions for local groups, schools, and stakeholders.
  • Strengthen the capacity of FCHVs, HMGs, and youth groups to lead sanitation initiatives.

7. Reporting & Documentation:

  • Prepare and submit high-quality concept notes, event reports, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and annual reportsin line with DJKYC/WAN requirements.
  • Document and disseminate success stories, case studies, lessons learned, and best practices at ward, municipal, and provincial levels.
  • Report specifically on slippage households, toilet reconstruction/repair progress, and adoption of toilet-use practices.
  • Contribute to knowledge products, manuals, and policy briefs for wider learning and advocacy.

8. Visibility, Branding & Media Mobilization:

  • Ensure compliance with donor and organizational visibility and branding guidelines in all community-level campaigns, IEC materials, and events.
  • Support to mobilize local and national media (print, FM radio, television) to amplify sanitation messages and project achievements.
  • Manage social media content creation and dissemination in coordination with DJKYC/WAN communications teams.
  • Support the development and dissemination of IEC publications, newsletters, and media briefs for awareness and outreach.

9. Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineer /Social Work, Sociology, Development Studies, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • Minimum 4–6 years’ experience in community mobilization and behavior change, preferably in WASH programs.
  • Proven leadership in designing and implementing sanitation campaigns and mobilizing community/government resources.
  • Experience in training, mentoring, and capacity building of community workers and volunteers.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with ability to engage diverse and marginalized groups.
  • Familiarity with local governance structures, ward-level planning, and CBO engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, achieve targets, and manage multiple stakeholders.
  • Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, data entry tools).
  • Familiar with m-Water and NWASH application.
  • Fluency in Nepali and Maithili; proficiency in English desirable.

VACANCY #-2

Admin and Finance Associate-1 

Job Description

Position Title: Admin and Finance Associate

Project: The Beacon Project

Reports to:  Finance & Admin Officer 

Duty Station: DJKYC Office , Gudigaun ,Lahan Municipality-10 , Siraha District

The Admin and Finance Associate will provide financial, administrative, and logistical support to The Beacon Project, ensuring transparent financial management, smooth day-to-day operations, and compliance with organizational and donor policies. 3. Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Certificate level or Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, related field.

  • Good knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and budget management.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team setting.

4. Competencies

  • Integrity, transparency, and accountability.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Time management and ability to prioritize tasks under pressure.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration.
  • Commitment to organizational values, gender equality, and safeguarding principles.

VACANCY #-3

Sanitation Campaign Activist / Social Mobilizer

Position Title: Sanitation Campaign Activist/Social Mobilizer-5

Location: DJKYC, Lahan Municipality, Siraha, Nepal

Reports To: Sanitation campaign  Coordinator, DJKYC

Duty Station: Lahan Municipality (with frequent field travel to assigned wards/settlements)

Contract Type: Project-based, with possibility of extension based on performance and funding

About the role:

The Sanitation Activist will play a key role in supporting through social mobilization for achieving household-level toilet coverage among poor and marginalized community in Lahan Municipality’s sanitation campaign by engaging communities, mobilizing youth volunteers, and promoting sanitation and hygiene behavior change. The role will strengthen the participation of marginalized households, schools, youth, women, and support groups to ensure sustained improvement in sanitation practices and open defecation free (ODF) progress, and strengthen hygiene practices, and improve WASH behavioursthrough community engagement, hygiene promotion, and technical support.

 Specific Job Description:

2. Mobilization & Facilitation :

  • Engage youth, women, and local groups to actively participate in sanitation campaigns.

  • Facilitate regular meetings, sharing sessions, and learning exchanges at community, ward, and municipal levels.
  • Support the formation and strengthening of local sanitation committees and women’s groups.
  • Encourage community ownership and participation to sustain ODF practices.

3. Behavior Change & Hygiene Promotion: 

  • Conduct hygiene behavior change (HBC) sessions in schools, households, and communities.
  • Promote toilet use, handwashing, and safe sanitation practices.
  • Address social stigma, cultural practices, and misconceptions related to sanitation.
  • Encourage adoption of inclusive hygiene practices among children, women, and marginalized groups.
  • Reinforce linkage between sanitation, health, and disease prevention.

4. Technical Support:

  • Support to provide guidance on toilet construction, repair, and low-cost models.
  • Support to train community members, youth volunteers, and local masons in sanitation technologies.
  • Assist monitor functionality, quality, and sustainability of constructed toilets.
  • Support to nsure technical support aligns with municipality/WASH guidelines and standards.
  • Assist households in selecting appropriate toilet models based on local context and affordability.

5. Data Collection & Monitoring:

  • Conduct household visits to identify slippage cases and gaps in toilet coverage.
  • Collect, compile, and report household-level sanitation data using municipality/WASH formats.
  • Document good practices, success stories, lessons learned, and campaign outcomes.
  • Maintain photo, video, and written evidence for ODF verification and reporting.
  • Support regular monitoring visits and provide recommendations to improve interventions.
  • Track behavioral change indicators and participation levels in sanitation campaigns.

6. Target Setting & Reporting:

  • Set monthly household coverage targets (toilet construction, repair, and use).
  • Track progress against targets and report to supervisors and municipal WASH units.
  • Document and report good practices, case stories, and lessons learned from campaign activities.
  • Prepare timely event reports, monthly progress reports, and updates for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to planning and evaluation of ward- and municipality-level sanitation campaigns.
  • Support data-driven decision-making to ensure equitable coverage and inclusion.

7. Visibility, Branding & Media Mobilization :

  • Document and showcase campaign activities through photos, videos, and success stories.
  • Share information with local media, social media, and community newsletters.
  • Promote DJKYC/WAN initiatives to increase awareness and community participation.
  • Highlight progress, innovations, and achievements in household toilet coverage.

8. Position Types & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s in Social Work, Public Health, Nursing, Sociology and 2 years' Social campaign mobilization experience or related Intermediate considered; 4 years or above, Social Campaign mobilization experience.
  • Experience working with poor &marginalized communities, schools, HCF and local government stakeholders.

9. Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong facilitation, negotiation, and interpersonal communication.
  • Ability to engage and motivate households and local groups.
  • Data collection, reporting, and basic computer skills (Word, Excel, mobile apps).
  • Fluency in Maithili, Nepali, and local languages.
  • Result-oriented, flexible, and able to work independently in field conditions.

10. Working Conditions:

11. Safeguarding and Code of Conduct:

The Social Campaign Mobilization Coordinator must adhere to DJKYC’s safeguarding policies, gender equality commitments, and code of conduct. Any form of exploitation, abuse, or discrimination is strictly prohibited.

﻿﻿Terms of Reference (ToR)

for

Consultancy on Documentary Production on intersectional vulnerabilities on migrants and their families due to labor migration in Nepal

FCA is Finland’s largest international aid organization with operations in 12 countries in Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Middle East. FCA has more than 70 years of experience and specializes in supporting local communities in three priority areas: Right to Quality Education, Right to Livelihood, and Right to Peace. We work with the poorest people, regardless of their religious beliefs, ethnic background or political convictions. As a civil society actor, FCA realizes its mission and vision through development cooperation, humanitarian assistance, advocacy work and impact investing.

FCA contributes to positive change by supporting people in the most vulnerable situations within fragile and disaster-affected areas. The main funding sources are from the Government of Finland, global institutional donors such as various UN agencies, bilateral donor agencies, and the EU, and private persons and companies. FCA enjoys Core Humanitarian Standards (CHS) certification and is a member of the ACT Alliance.

With a commitment to bring about positive development through collaboration, FCA has been supporting development work in Nepal since the 1980s and has had an in-country presence since 2013. The long-term change that FCA wants to see in Nepal is that marginalized women and youth are socio-economically empowered and enjoy a decent living. FCA’s work in Nepal focuses on livelihood and education, both as long-term development projects and disaster response and recovery programs. The peace theme is integrated throughout the program with all projects having a clear focus on social inclusion, participation and non-discrimination. The current Nepal country program is implemented in Madhesh, Karnali, and Sudurpaschim Provinces.
